english: I take no delight in my gardens nor have any pleasure in women; I feel no joy at the prospect of riches, but enjoy my solace in my own heart and mind.

sanskrit: anityaścāsukho lokastṛṣṇā tāta durudvahā / cāpalopahataṃ cetaḥ kathaṃ yāsyāmi nirvṛtim //
english: Frail are the pleasures of the world, and avarice is altogether intolerable; the bustle of business has broken down my heart, and (I know not) where to have my tranquility.

sanskrit: nābhinandāmi maraṇaṃ nābhinandāmi jīvitam / yathā tiṣṭhāmi tiṣṭhāmi tathaiva vigatajvaram //
english: Neither do I hail death nor am I in love with my life; but remain as I do, devoid of all anxiety and care.

sanskrit: kiṃ me rājyena kiṃ bhogaiḥ kimarthena kimīhitaiḥ / ahaṃkāravaśādetatsa eva galito mama //
english: What have I to do with a kingdom and with all its enjoyments? Of what avail are riches to me, and what is the end of all our exertions? All these are but requirements of self-love, from which I am entirely free.

sanskrit: janmāvalivaratrāyāmindriyagranthayo dṛḍhāḥ / ye baddhāstadvimokṣārthaṃ yatante ye ta uttamāḥ //
english: The chain of (repeated) births is a bond that binds fast all men by its strong knots of the senses; those striving to break loose from this bondage for their liberation, are (said to be) the best of men.

sanskrit: mathitaṃ māninīlokairmano makaraketunā / komalaṃ khuraniṣpeṣaiḥ kamalaṃ kariṇā yathā //
english: These haughty damsels whom the god of love employs to ravage the hearts of men, resemble a group of elephants subverting a lotus bed under their feet.

sanskrit: adya cetsvacchayā buddhyā munīndra na cikitsyate / bhūyaścittacikitsāyāstatkilāvasaraḥ kutaḥ //
english: The treatment of the mind with pure reason being neglected now (in youth), it is hard to heal it afterwards (in age), when it admits of no cure.

sanskrit: viṣaṃ viṣayavaiṣamyaṃ na viṣaṃ viṣamucyate / janmāntaraghnā viṣayā ekadehaharaṃ viṣam //
english: It is the worldliness of man that is his true poison, while real poison is no poison to him. It is the poison of worldliness which destroys his future life, while real poison is only locally injurious to him.

sanskrit: na sukhāni na duḥkhāni na mitrāṇi na bāndhavāḥ / na jīvitaṃ na maraṇaṃ bandhāya jñasya cetasaḥ //
english: Neither pleasure nor pain, nor friends nor relatives, nor even life and death, can enchain (affect) the mind that has received the light of truth.

sanskrit: tadbhavāmi yathā brahmanpūrvāparavidāṃ vara / vītaśokabhayāyāso jñastathopadiśāśu me //
english: Teach me, Oh Brahman! that art the best of the learned in the mysteries of the past and future, teach me so that I may soon become like one devoid of grief and fear and worldly troubles, and may have the light of truth beaming upon me.

sanskrit: vāsanājālavalitā duḥkhakaṇṭakasaṃkulā / nipātotpātabahulā bhīmarūpā'jñatāṭavī //
english: The forest of ignorance is laid over with the snare of desire, it is full of the thorns of misery, and is the dreadful seat of destruction and the danger.

sanskrit: krakacāgraviniṣpeṣaṃ soḍhuṃ śaknomyahaṃ mune / saṃsāravyavahārotthaṃ nāśāviṣayavaiśasam //
english: I can rather suffer myself to be put under the jaws of death with his rows of teeth like saws, but cannot bear the dreadly pains of worldly cares and anxieties.

sanskrit: idaṃ nāstīdamastīti vyavahārāñjanabhramaḥ / dhunotīdaṃ calaṃ ceto rajorāśimivānilaḥ //
english: It is a gloomy error in this world to think that I have this and have not the other; it serves to toss about our minds as a gust of wind disperses the dust of the earth.

sanskrit: tṛṣṇātantulavaprotaṃ jīvasaṃcayamauktikam / cidacchāṅgatayā nityaṃ vikasaccittanāyakam //
english: It is the thread of avarice that links together all living beings like a chaplet of pearls; the mind serves to twirl about this chain, but pure consciousness sits quiet to observe its rotation.

sanskrit: saṃsārahāramaratiḥ kālavyālavibhūṣaṇam / troṭayāmyahamakrūraṃ vāgurāmiva kesarī //
english: I who am devoid of desires, would like to break this ornamental chain of worldliness, hanging about me as a deadly serpent, in the same manner, as a lion breaks asunder the net.

sanskrit: nīhāraṃ hṛdayāṭavyāṃ manastimiramāśu me / kena vijñānadīpena bhindhi tattvavidāṃvara //
english: Do you now, O most learned sage, scatter the mist which has overspread the forest of my heart, and the darkness which has overcast my mind, by the light of true knowledge.

sanskrit: vidyanta eveha na te mahātman durādhayo na kṣayamāpnuvanti / ye saṅgamenottamamānasānāṃ niśātamāṃsīva niśākareṇa //
english: There are no anxieties, O sage! which cannot be put to an end by the society of good minded men; the darkness of night can be well removed by moon-beams.

sanskrit: āyurvāyuvighaṭṭitābhrapaṭalīlambāmbuvadbhaṅguraṃ bhogā meghavitānamadhyavilasatsaudāminīcañcalāḥ / lolāyauvanalālanājalarayaścetyākalayya drutaṃ mudraivādya dṛḍhārpitā nanu mayā citte ciraṃ śāntaye //
english: Life is as fickle as a drop of water pending on a mass of clouds blown away by the winds. Our enjoyments are as unsteady as the lightning that flickers in the midst of clouds. The pleasures of youth are as slippery as water. With these reflections in my mind, I have subdued them all under the province of peace and tranquility.

sanskrit: śrīrāma uvāca / evamabhyutthitānarthaśatasaṃkaṭakoṭare / jagadālokya nirmagnaṃ mano mananakardame //
english: Seeing the world thus ingulphed amidst the abyss of hundreds of rising dangers and difficulties, my mind is immerged in the mire of anxieties.

sanskrit: mano me bhramatīvedaṃ saṃbhramaścopajāyate / gātrāṇi parikampante patrāṇīva jarattaroḥ //
english: My mind is wandering everywhere and I am struck with fear at every thing; my limbs are shaking with fear like the leaves of a withered tree.

sanskrit: anāptottamasaṃtoṣadhairyotsaṅgākulā matiḥ / śūnyāspadā bibhetīha bālevālpabaleśvarā //
english: My mind is bewildered by impatience for its want of true contentment, just as a young woman is afraid in a desert for want of the company of her strong handed husband.

sanskrit: vikalpebhyo luṭhantyetāścāntaḥkaraṇavṛttayaḥ / śvabhrebhya iva sāraṅgāstucchālambaviḍambitāḥ //
english: The thoughts of my mind are entangled in my desire for worldly enjoyments, as stags are caught in the pit strewn with grass over it.

sanskrit: avivekāspadā bhraṣṭāḥ kaṣṭe rūḍhā na satpade / andhakūpamivāpannā varākāścakṣurādayaḥ //
english: The senses of an unreasonable man, ever run astray to the wrong and never turn to the right way; so the eyes of a blind man lead him but to fall into the pit.

sanskrit: nāvasthitimupāyāti na ca yāti yathepsitam / cintā jīveśvarāyattā kānteva priyasadmani //
english: Human thoughts are linked to the animal soul as consorts to their lords. They can neither sit idle nor ramble at liberty, but must remain as wives under the control of their husbands.

sanskrit: apa tyam pari panthinam muṣīvāṇam huraḥ citam dūram adhi sruteḥ aja
english: Who lurks about the path we take, the robber with a guileful heart: Far from the road chase him away.

sanskrit: tvam tasya dvayāvinaḥ agha saṁsasya kasya cit padā abhi tiṣṭha tapuṣim
english: Tread with thy foot and trample out the firebrand of the wicked one, The double-tongued, whoe'er he be.

sanskrit: ā tat te dasra mantu maḥ pūṣan avaḥ vr̥ṇīmahe yena pitr̥r̥n acodayaḥ
english: Wise Pûshan, Wonder-Worker, we claim of thee now the aid wherewith Thou furtheredst our sires of old.

sanskrit: adhaḥ naḥ viśva saubhaga hiraṇyavāśīmat tama dhanāni su sanā kr̥dhi
english: So, Lord of all prosperity, best wielder of the golden sword, Make riches easy to be won.

sanskrit: ati naḥ saścataḥ naya su gā naḥ su pathā kr̥ṇu pūṣan iha kratum vidaḥ
english: Past all pursuers lead us, make pleasant our path and fair to tread: O Pûshan, find thou power for this.

sanskrit: abhi su yavasam naya na nava jvāraḥ adhvane pūṣan iha kratum vidaḥ
english: Lead us to meadows rich in grass: send on our way no early heat: O Pûshan, find thou power for this.

sanskrit: śagdhi pūrdhi pra yaṁsi ca śiśīhi prāsi udaram pūṣan iha kratum vidaḥ
english: Be gracious to us, fill us full, give, feed us, and invigorate: O Pûshan, find thou power for this.

sanskrit: na pūṣaṇam methāmasi sūktaiḥ abhi gr̥ṇīmasi vasūni dasmam īmahe
english: No blame have we for Pûshan; him we magnify with songs of praise: We seek the Mighty One for wealth.

sanskrit: kat rudrāya pra cetase mīl̥huḥ tamāya tavyase vocema śam tamam hr̥de
english: WHAT shall we sing to Rudra, strong, most bounteous, excellently wise, That shall be dearest to his heart?

sanskrit: yathā naḥ aditiḥ karat paśve nr̥ bhyaḥ yathā gave yathā tokāya rudriyam
english: That Aditi may grant the grace of Rudra to our folk, our kine, Our cattle and our progeny;

sanskrit: yathā naḥ mitraḥ varuṇaḥ yathā rudraḥ ciketati yathā viśve sa joṣasaḥ
english: That Mitra and that Varuṇa, that Rudra may remember us, Yea, all the Gods with one accord.

sanskrit: gātha patim medha patim rudram jalāṣa bheṣajam tat śam yoḥ sumnam īmahe
english: To Rudra Lord of sacrifice, of hymns and balmy medicines, We pray for joy and health and strength.

sanskrit: yaḥ śukraḥ iva sūryaḥ hiraṇyam iva rocate śreṣṭhaḥ devānām vasuḥ
english: He shines in splendour like the Sun, refulgent as bright gold is he, The good, the best among the Gods.

sanskrit: śan naḥ karati arvate su gam meṣāya meṣye nr̥ bhyaḥ nāri bhyaḥ gave
english: May he grant health into our steeds, wellbeing to our rams and ewes, To men, to women, and to kine.

sanskrit: asme iti soma śriyam adhi ni dhehi śatasya nr̥ṇām mahi śravaḥ tuvi nr̥mṇam
english: O Soma, set thou upon us the glory of a hundred men, The great renown of mighty chiefs.

sanskrit: mā naḥ soma paribādhaḥ mā arātayaḥ juhuranta ā naḥ indo iti vāje bhaja
english: Let not malignities, nor those who trouble Soma, hinder us. Indu, give us a share of strength.

sanskrit: yāḥ te pra jāḥ amr̥tasya parasmin dhāman r̥tasya mūrdhā nābhā soma venaḥ ābhūṣantīḥ soma vedaḥ
english: Soma! head, central point, love these; Soma! know these as serving thee, Children of thee Immortal, at the highest place of holy law.

sanskrit: agne vivasvat uṣasaḥ citram rādhaḥ amartya ā dāśuṣe jāta vedaḥ vaha tvam adya devām uṣaḥ budhaḥ
english: IMMORTAL Jâtavedas, thou many-hued fulgent gift of Dawn, Agni, this day to him who pays oblations bring the Gods who waken with the morn.

sanskrit: juṣṭaḥ hi dūtaḥ asi havya vāhanaḥ agne rathīḥ adhvarāṇām sa jūḥ aśvi bhyām uṣasā su vīryam asme iti dhehi śravaḥ br̥hat
english: For thou art offering-bearer and loved messenger, the charioteer of sacrifice: Accordant with the Aṣvins and with Dawn grant us heroic strength and lofty fame.

sanskrit: adya dūtam vr̥ṇīmahe vasum agnim puru priyam dhūma ketum bhāḥ r̥jīkam vi uṣṭiṣu yajñānām adhvara śriyam
english: As messenger we choose to-day Agni the good whom many love, Smoke-bannered spreader of the light, at break of day glory of sacrificial rites.

sanskrit: śreṣṭham yaviṣṭham atithim su āhutam juṣṭam janāya dāśuṣe devān accha yātave jāta vedasam agnim īl̥e vi uṣṭiṣu
english: Him noblest and most youthful, richly worshipped guest, dear to the men who offer gifts, Him, Agni Jâtavedas, I beseech at dawn that he may bring the Gods to us.

sanskrit: staviṣyāmi tvām aham viśvasya amr̥ta bhojana agne trātāram amr̥tam miyedhya yajiṣṭham havya vāhana
english: Thee, Agni, will I glorify, deathless nourisher of the world, Immortal, offering-bearer, meet for sacred food, preserver, best at sacrifice.

sanskrit: suśaṁsaḥ bodhi gr̥ṇate yaviṣṭhya madhu jihvaḥ su āhutaḥ praskaṇvasya pra tiran āyuḥ jīvase namasya daivyam janam
english: Tell good things to thy praiser, O most youthful God, as richly worshipped, honey-tongued, And, granting to Praskaṇva lengthened days of life, show honour to the Heavenly Host.

sanskrit: hotāram viśva vedasam sam hi tvā viśaḥ indhate saḥ ā vaha puru hūta pra cetasaḥ agne devān iha dravat
english: For the men, Agni, kindle thee as all possessor and as Priest; So Agni, much-invoked, bring hither with all speed the Gods, the excellently wise,

sanskrit: savitāram uṣasam aśvinā bhagam agnim vi uṣṭiṣu kṣapaḥ kaṇvāsaḥ tvā suta somāsaḥ indhate havya vāham su adhvara
english: At dawn of day, at night, Ushas and Savitar, the Aṣvins, Bhaga, Agni's self: Skilled in fair rites, with Soma poured, the Kaṇvas light thee, the oblation-wafting God.

sanskrit: patiḥ hi adhvarāṇām agne dūtaḥ viśām asi uṣaḥ budhaḥ ā vaha soma pītaye devān adya svaḥ dr̥śaḥ
english: For, Agni, Lord of sacrifice and messenger of men art thou: Bring thou the Gods who wake at dawn who see the light, this day to drink the Soma juice.

sanskrit: agne pūrvāḥ anu uṣasaḥ vibhāvaso itivibhāvaso dīdetha viśva darśataḥ asi grāmeṣu avitā puraḥ hitaḥ asi yajñeṣu mānuṣaḥ
english: Thou shonest forth, O Agni, after former dawns, all visible, O rich in light. Thou art our help in battle-strife, the Friend of inan, the great high priest in sacrifice.

sanskrit: ni tvā yajñasya sādhanam agne hotāram r̥tvijam manuṣvat deva dhīmahi pra cetasam jīram dūtam amartyam
english: Like Manu, we will stablish thee, Agni, performer of the rite, Invoker, ministering Priest, exceeding wise, the swift immortal messenger.

sanskrit: yat devānām mitra mahaḥ puraḥ hitaḥ antaraḥ yāsi dūtyam sindhoḥ iva pra svanitāsaḥ ūrmayaḥ agneḥ bhrājante arcayaḥ
english: When as the Gods' High Priest, by many loved, thou dost their mission as their nearest Friend, Then, like the far-resounding billows of the flood, thy flames, O Agni, roar aloud.

sanskrit: śrudhi śrut karṇa vahni bhiḥ devaiḥ agne sayāva bhiḥ ā sīdantu barhiṣi mitraḥ aryamā prātaḥ yāvānaḥ adhvaram
english: Heat-, Agni, who hast ears to hear, with all thy train of escort Gods; Let Mitra, Aryaman,– seeking betimes our rite, seat them upon the sacred grass.

sanskrit: śr̥ṇvantu somam marutaḥ su dānavaḥ agni jihvāḥ r̥ta vr̥dhaḥ pibatu somam varuṇaḥ dhr̥ta vrataḥ aśvi bhyām uṣasā sa jūḥ
english: Let those who strengthen Law, who bountifully give, the life-tongued Maruts, hear our praise. May Law-supporting Varuṇa with the Aṣvins twain and Ushas, drink the Soma juice.

sanskrit: tvam agne vasūn iha rudrān ādityān uta yaja su adhvaram janam manu jātam ghr̥ta pruṣam
english: WORSHIP the Vasus, Agni! here, the Rudras, the Âdityas, all Who spring from Manu, those who know fair rites, who pour their blessings down.

sanskrit: śruṣṭī vānaḥ hi dāśuṣe devāḥ agne vicetasaḥ tān rohit aśva girvaṇaḥ trayaḥ triṁśatam ā vaha
english: Agni, the Gods who understand give ear unto the worshipper: Lord of Red Steeds, who lovest song, bring thou those Three-and-Thirty Gods.

sanskrit: priyamedha vat atri vat jāta vedaḥ virūpa vat aṅgirasvat mahi vrata praskaṇvasya śrudhi havam
english: O Jâtavedas, great in act, hearken thou to Praskaṇva's call, As Priyamedha erst was heard, Atri, Virûpa, Angiras.

sanskrit: mahi keravaḥ ūtaye priya medhāḥ ahūṣata rājantam adhvarāṇām agnim śukreṇa śociṣā
english: The sons of Priyamedha skilled in lofty praise have called for help On Agni who with fulgent flame is Ruler of all holy rites.

sanskrit: ghr̥ta āhavana santya imāḥ oṁ iti su śrudhi giraḥ yābhiḥ kaṇvasya sūnavaḥ havante avase tvā
english: Hear thou, invoked withholy oil, bountiful giver of rewards, These eulogies, whereby the sons of Kaṇva call thee to their aid.

sanskrit: tvām citraśravaḥ tama havante vikṣu jantavaḥ śociḥ keśam puru priya agne havyāya vol̥have
english: O Agni, loved by many, thou of fame most wondrous, in their homes Men call on thee whose hair is flame, to be the bearer of their gifts.

sanskrit: ni tvā hotāram r̥tvijam dadhire vasuvit tamam śrut karṇam saprathaḥ tamam viprāḥ agne diviṣṭiṣu
english: Thee, Agni, best to find out wealth, most widely famous, quick to hear, Singers have stablished in their rites Herald and ministering Priest.

sanskrit: ā tvā viprāḥ acucyavuḥ suta somāḥ abhi prayaḥ br̥hat bhāḥ bibhrataḥ haviḥ agne martāya dāśuṣe
english: Singers with Soma pressed have made thee, Agni, hasten to the feast, Great light to mortal worshipper, what time they bring the sacred gift.

sanskrit: prātaḥ yāvnaḥ sahaḥ kr̥ta soma peyāya santya iha adya daivyam janam barhiḥ ā sādaya vaso iti
english: Good, bounteous, Son of Strength, this day seat here on sacred grass the Gods Who come at early morn, the host of heaven, to drink the Soma juice

sanskrit: arvāñcam daivyam janam agne yakṣva sahūti bhiḥ ayam somaḥ su dānavaḥ tam pāta tiraḥ ahnyam
english: Bring with joint invocations thou, O Agni, the celestial host: Here stands the Soma, bounteous Gods drink this expressed ere yesterday.

sanskrit: eṣo iti uṣāḥ apūrvyā vi ucchati priyā divaḥ stuṣe vām aśvinā br̥hat
english: Now Morning with her earliest light shines forth, dear Daughter of the Sky: High, Aṣvins, I extol your praise,

sanskrit: yā dasrā sindhu mātarā manotarā rayīṇām dhiyā devā vasu vidā
english: Sons of the Sea, mighty to save discoverers of riches, ye Gods with deep thought who find out wealth.

sanskrit: vacyante vām kakuhāsaḥ jūrṇāyām adhi viṣṭapi yat vām rathaḥ vi bhiḥ patāt
english: Your giant coursers hasten on over the region all in flames, – When your car flies with winged steeds.

sanskrit: haviṣā jāraḥ apām piparti papuriḥ narā pitā kuṭasya carṣaṇiḥ
english: He, liberal, lover of the flood, Lord of the House, the vigilant, Chiefs! with oblations feeds you full.

sanskrit: ādāraḥ vām matīnām nāsatyā mata vacasā pātam somasya dhr̥ṣṇu yā
english: Ye have regard unto our hymns, Nâsatyas, thinking of our words: Drink boldly of the Soma juice.

sanskrit: yā naḥ pīparat aśvinā jyotiṣmatī tamaḥ tiraḥ tām asme iti rāsāthām iṣam
english: Vouchsafe to us, O Aṣvin Pair, such strength as, with attendant light, May through the darkness carry us.

sanskrit: ā naḥ nāvā matīnām yātam pārāya gantave yuñjāthām aśvinā ratham
english: Come in the ship of these our hymns to bear you to the hither shore O Aṣvins, harness ye the car.

sanskrit: aritram vām divaḥ pr̥thu tīrthe sindhūnām rathaḥ dhiyā yuyujre indavaḥ
english: The heaven's wide vessel is your own on the flood's shore your chariot waits Drops, with the hymn, have been prepared.

sanskrit: divaḥ kaṇvāsaḥ indavaḥ vasu sindhūnām pade svam vavrim kuha dhitsathaḥ
english: Kaṇvas, the drops are in the heaven; the wealth is at the waters' place: Where will ye manifest your form?

sanskrit: abhūt oṁ iti bhāḥ oṁ iti aṁśave hiraṇyam prati sūryaḥ vi akhyat jihvayā asitaḥ
english: Light came to lighten up the branch, the Sun appeared as it were gold: And with its-tongue shone forth the dark.

sanskrit: abhūt oṁ iti pāram etave panthā r̥tasya sādhu yā adarśi vi srutiḥ divaḥ
english: The path of sacrifice was made to travel to the farther goal: The road of heaven was manifest.

sanskrit: tat tat it aśvinoḥ avaḥ jaritā prati bhūṣati made somasya pipratoḥ
english: The singer of their praise awaits whatever grace the Aṣvins give, who save when Soma gladdens them.

sanskrit: vāvasānā vivasvati somasya pītyā girā manuṣvat śambhūitiśam bhū ā gatam
english: Ye dwellers with Vivasvan come, auspicious, as to Manu erst; come to the Soma and our praise.

sanskrit: yuvoḥ uṣāḥ anu śriyam pari jmanoḥ upa ācarat r̥tā vanathaḥ aktu bhiḥ
english: O circumambient Aṣvins, Dawn follows the brightness of your way: Approve with beams our solemn rites.

sanskrit: ubhā pibatam aśvinā ubhā naḥ śarma yacchatam avidriyābhiḥ ūtibhiḥ
english: Drink ye of our libations, grant protection, O ye Aṣvins Twain, With aids which none may interrupt.

sanskrit: ayam vām madhumat tamaḥ sutaḥ somaḥ r̥ta vr̥dhā tam aśvinā pibatam tiraḥ ahnyam dhattam ratnāni dāśuṣe
english: ASVINS, for you who strengthen Law this sweetest Soma hath been shed. Drink this expressed ere yesterday and give riches to him who offers it.

sanskrit: tri vandhureṇa tri vr̥tā su peśasā rathena ā yātam aśvinā kaṇvāsaḥ vām brahma kr̥ṇvanti adhvare teṣām su śr̥ṇutam havam
english: Come, O ye Aṣvins, mounted on your triple car three-seated, beautiful of form To you at sacrifice the Kaṇvas send the prayer: graciously listen to their call.

sanskrit: aśvinā madhumat tamam pātam somam r̥ta vr̥dhā atha adya dasrā vasu bibhratā rathe dāsvāṁsam upa gacchatam
english: O Aṣvins, ye who strengthen Law, drink ye this sweetest Soma juice. Borne on your wealth-fraught car come ye this day to him who offers, ye of wondrous deeds.

sanskrit: triṣ sadhasthe barhiṣi viśva vedasā madhvā yajñam mimikṣatam kaṇvāsaḥ vām suta somāḥ abhi dyavaḥ yuvām havante aśvinā
english: Omniscient Aṣvins, on the thrice-heaped grass bedew with the sweet juice the sacrifice. The sons of Kaṇva, striving heavenward, call on you with draughts of Soma juice out-poured.

sanskrit: yābhiḥ kaṇvam abhiṣṭi bhiḥ pra āvatam yuvam aśvinā tābhiḥ su asmān avatam śubhaḥ patī iti pātam somam r̥ta vr̥dhā
english: O Aṣvins, with those aids wherewith ye guarded Kaṇva carefully, Keep us, O hords of Splendour: drink the Soma juice, ye strengtheners of holy law.

sanskrit: su dāse dasrā vasu bibhratā rathe pr̥kṣaḥ vahatam aśvinā rayim samudrāt uta vā divaḥ pari asme iti dhattam puru spr̥ham
english: O Mighty Ones, ye gave Sudâs abundant food, brought on your treasure-laden car; So now vouchsafe to us the wealth which many crave, either from heaven or from the sea.

sanskrit: yat nāsatyā parāvati yat vā sthaḥ adhi turvaśe ataḥ rathena su vr̥tā naḥ ā gatam sākam sūryasya raśmi bhiḥ
english: Nâsatyas, whether ye be far away or close to Turvaṣa, Borne on your lightly-rolling chariot come to us, together with the sunbeams come.

sanskrit: arvāñcā vām saptayaḥ adhvara śriyaḥ vahantu savanā it upa iṣam pr̥ñcantā su kr̥te su dānave ā barhiḥ sidatam narā
english: So let your coursers, ornaments of sacrifice, bring you to our libations here. Bestowing food on him who acts and gives aright, sit, Chiefs, upon the sacred grass.

sanskrit: tena nāsatyā ā gatam rathena sūrya tvacā yena śaśvat ūhathuḥ dāśuṣe vasu madhvaḥ somasya pītaye
english: Come, O Nâsatyas, on your car decked with a sunbright canopy, Whereon ye ever bring wealth to the worshipper, to drink the Soma's pleasant juice.

sanskrit: ukthebhiḥ arvāk avase puruvasūitipuru vasū arkaiḥ ca ni hvayāmahe śaśvat kaṇvānām sadasi priye hi kam somam papathuḥ aśvinā
english: With lauds and songs of praise we call them down to us, that they, most rich, may succour us; For ye have ever in the Kaṇvas' well-loved house, O Aṣvins, drunk the Soma juice.

sanskrit: saha vāmena naḥ uṣaḥ vi uccha duhitaḥ divaḥ saha dyumnena br̥hatā vibhāvari rāyā devi dāsvatī
english: DAWN on us with prosperity, O Ushas, Daughter of the Sky, Dawn with great glory, Goddess, Lady of the Light, dawn thou with riches, Bounteous One.

sanskrit: aśva vatīḥ go matīḥ viśva suvidaḥ bhūri cyavanta vastave ut īraya prati mā sūnr̥tāḥ uṣaḥ coda rādhaḥ maghonām
english: They, bringing steeds and kine, boon-givers of all wealth, have oft sped forth to lighten us. O Ushas, waken up for me the sounds of joy: send us the riches of the great.

sanskrit: uvāsa uṣāḥ ucchāt ca nu devī jīrā rathānām ye asyāḥ ācaraṇeṣu dadhrire samudre na śravasyavaḥ
english: Ushas hath dawned, and now shall dawn, the Goddess, driver forth of cars Which, as she cometh nigh, have fixed their thought on her, like glory-seekers on the flood.

sanskrit: uṣaḥ ye te pra yāmeṣu yuñjate manaḥ dānāya sūrayaḥ atra aha tat kaṇvaḥ eṣām kaṇva tamaḥ nāma gr̥ṇāti nr̥ṇām
english: Here Kaṇva, chief of Kaṇva's race, sings forth aloud the glories of the heroes' names,– The. princes who, O Ushas, as thou comest near, direct their thoughts to liberal gifts.

sanskrit: ā gha yoṣāiva sūnarī uṣāḥ yāti pra bhuñjatī jarayantī vr̥janam pat vat īyate ut pātayati pakṣiṇaḥ
english: Like a good matron Ushas comes carefully tending everything: Rousing all life she stirs all creatures that have feet, and makes the birds of air fly up.

sanskrit: vi yā sr̥jati samanam vi arthinaḥ padam na veti odatī vayaḥ naki ḥ te paptivāṁsaḥ āsatevi uṣṭau vājinī vati
english: She sends the busy forth, each man to his pursuit: delay she knows not as she springs. O rich in opulence, after thy dawning birds that have flown forth no longer rest.

sanskrit: eṣā ayukta parāvataḥ sūryasya ut ayanāt adhi śatam rathebhiḥ su bhagā uṣāḥ iyam vi yāti abhi mānuṣān
english: This Dawn hath yoked her steeds afar, beyond the rising of the Sun: Borne on a hundred chariots she, auspicious Dawn, advances on her way to Men.

sanskrit: viśvam asyāḥ nanāma cakṣase jagat jyotiḥ kr̥ṇoti sūnarī apa dveṣaḥ maghonī divaḥ uṣāḥ ucchat apa sridhaḥ
english: To meet her glance all living creatures bend them down: Excellent One, she makes the light. Ushas, the Daughter of the Sky, the opulent, shines foes and enmities away.

sanskrit: uṣaḥ ā bhāhi bhānunā candreṇa duhitaḥ divaḥ āvahantī bhūri asmabhyam saubhagam vi ucchantī diviṣṭiṣu
english: Shine on us with thy radiant light, O Ushas, Daughter of the Sky, Bringing to us great store of high felicity, and bearning on our solemn rites.

sanskrit: viśvasya hi prāṇanam jīvanam tve iti vi yat ucchasi sūnari sā naḥ rathena br̥hatā vibhāvari śrudhi citra maghe havam
english: For in thee is each living creature's breath and life, when, Excellent! thou dawnest forth. Borne on thy lofty car, O Lady of the Light, hear, thou of wondrous wealth, our call.

sanskrit: uṣaḥ vājam hi vaṁsva yaḥ citraḥ mānuṣe jane tena ā vaha su kr̥taḥ adhvarān upa ye tvā gr̥ṇanti vahnayaḥ
english: O Ushas, win thyself the strength which among men is wonderful. Bring thou thereby the pious unto holy rites, those who as priests sing praise to thee.

sanskrit: viśvān devān ā vaha soma pītaye antarikṣāt uṣaḥ tvam sā asmāsu ghāḥ go mat aśva vat ukthyam uṣaḥ vājam su vīryam
english: Bring from the firmament, O Ushas, all the Gods, that they may drink our Soma juice, And, being what thou art, vouchsafe us kine and steeds, strength meet for praist and hero might.

sanskrit: yasyāḥ ruśantaḥ arcayaḥ prati bhadrāḥ adr̥kṣata sā naḥ rayim v iśva vāram su peśasam uṣāḥ dadātu sugmyam
english: May Ushas whose auspicious rays are seen resplendent round about, Grant us great riches, fair in form, of all good things, wealth which light labour may attain.

sanskrit: ye cit hi tvām r̥ṣayaḥ pūrve ūtaye juhūre avase mahi sā naḥ stomān abhi gr̥ṇīhi rādhasā uṣaḥ śukreṇa śociṣā
english: Mighty One, whom the R̥ishis of old time invoked for their protection and their help, O Ushas, graciously answer our songs of praise with bounty and with brilliant light.

sanskrit: uṣaḥ yat adya bhānunā vi dvārau r̥ṇavaḥ divaḥ pra naḥ yacchatāt avr̥kam pr̥thu chardiḥ pra devi go matīḥ iṣaḥ
english: Ushas, as thou with light to day hast opened the twin doors of heaven, So grant thou us a dwelling wide and free from foes. O Goddess, give us food with kine.

sanskrit: sam naḥ rāyā br̥hatā viśva peśasā mimikṣva sam il̥ābhiḥ ā sam dyumnena viśva turā uṣaḥ mahi sam vājaiḥ vājinī vati
english: Bring us to wealth abundant, sent in every shape, to plentiful refreshing food, To all-subduing splendour, Ushas, Mighty One, to strength, thou rich in spoil and wealth.

sanskrit: uṣaḥ bhadrebhiḥ ā gahi divaḥ cit rocanāt adhi vahantu aruṇa psavaḥ upa tvā sominaḥ gr̥ham
english: E'EN from above the sky's bright realm come, Ushas, by auspicious ways: Let red steeds bear thee to the house of him who pours the Soma, juice.

sanskrit: su peśasam sukham ratham yam adhi asthāḥ uṣaḥ tvam tena su śravasam janam pra ava adya duhitaḥ divaḥ
english: The chariot which thou mountest, fair of shape, O Ushas light to move,– Therewith, O Daughter of the Sky, aid men of noble fame today.

sanskrit: vayaḥ cit te patatriṇaḥ dvipat catuḥ pat arjuni uṣaḥ pra āran r̥tūn anu divaḥ antebhyaḥ pari
english: Bright Ushas, when thy times return, all quadrupeds and bipeds stir, And round about flock winged birds from all theboundaries of heaven.

sanskrit: vyi ucchantī hi raśmi bhiḥ viśvam ābhāsi rocanam tām tvām uṣaḥ vasu yavaḥ gīḥ bhiḥ kaṇvāḥ ahūṣata
english: Thou dawning with thy beams of light illumest all the radiant realm. Thee, as thou art, the Kaṇvas, fain for wealth, have called with sacred songs.

sanskrit: ut oṁ iti tyam jāta vedasam devam vahanti ketavaḥ dr̥śe viśvāya sūryam
english: HIS bright rays bear him up aloft, the God who knoweth all that lives, Sûrya, that all may look on him.

sanskrit: apa tye tāyavaḥ yathā nakṣatrā yanti aktu bhiḥ sūrāya viśva cakṣase
english: The constellations pass away, like thieves, together with their beams, Before the all-beholding Sun'

sanskrit: adr̥śram asya ketavaḥ vi raśmayaḥ janān anu bhrājantaḥ agnayaḥ yathā
english: His herald rays are seen afar refulgent o'er the world of men, Like flames of fire that burn and blaze.

sanskrit: taraṇiḥ viśva darśataḥ jyotiḥ kr̥t asi sūrya viśvam ā bhāsi rocanam
english: Swift and all beautiful art thou, O Sûrya, maker of the light, Illuming all the radiant realm.

sanskrit: pratyaṅ devānām viśaḥ pratyaṅ ut eṣi mānuṣān pratyaṅ viśvam svaḥ dr̥śe
english: Thou goest to the hosts of Gods, thou comest hither to mankind, Hither all light to be belield.

sanskrit: yena pāvaka cakṣasā bhuraṇyantam janān anu tvam varuṇa paśyasi
english: With that same eye of thine wherewith thou lookest brilliant Varuṇa, Upon the busy race of men,

sanskrit: vi dyām eṣi rajaḥ pr̥thu ahā mimānaḥ aktu bhiḥ paśyan janmāni sūyar
english: traversing sky and wide mid-air, thou metest with thy beams our days, Sun, seeing all things that have birth.

sanskrit: sapta tvā haritaḥ rathe vahanti deva sūrya śociḥ keśam vi cakṣaṇa
english: Seven Bay Steeds harnessed to thy car bear thee, O thou farseeing One, God, Sûrya, with the radiant hair.

sanskrit: ayukta sapta śundhyuvaḥ sūraḥ rathasya naptyaḥ tābhiḥ yāti svayukti bhiḥ
english: Sûrya hath yoked the pure bright Seven, the daughters of the car; with these, His own dear team, he goeth forth.

sanskrit: ut vayam tamasaḥ pari jyotiḥ paśyantaḥ ut taram devam deva trā sūryam aganma jyotiḥ ut tamam
english: Looking upon the loftier light above the darkness we have come To Sûrya, God among the Gods, the light that is most excellent.

sanskrit: ut yan adya mitra mahaḥ ārohan ut tarām divam hr̥t rogam mama sūrya harimāṇam ca nāśaya
english: Rising this day, O rich in friends, ascending to the loftier heaven, Sûrya remove my heart's disease, take from me this my yellow hue.

sanskrit: śukeṣu me harimāṇam ropaṇākāsu dadhmasi atho iti hāridraveṣu me harimāṇam ni dadhmasi
english: To parrots and to starlings let us give away my yellowness, Or this my yellowness let us transfer to Haritâla trees.

sanskrit: ut agāt ayam ādityaḥ viśvena sahasā saha dviṣantam mahyam randhayan mo iti aham dviṣate radham
english: With all his conquering vigour this Âditya hath gone up on high, Giving my foe into mine hand: let me not be my foeman's prey.

sanskrit: abhi tyam meṣam puru hūtam r̥gmiyam indram gīḥ bhiḥ madata vasvaḥ arṇavam yasya dyāvaḥ na vi caranti mānuṣā bhuje maṁhiṣṭham abhi vipram arcata
english: MAKE glad with songs that Ram whom many men invoke, worthy of songs of praise, Indra, the sea of wealth; Whose gracious deeds for men spread like the heavens abroad: sing praise to him the Sage, most liberal for our good.

sanskrit: abhi īm avanvan su abhiṣṭim ūtayaḥ antarikṣa prām taviṣībhiḥ āvr̥tam indram dakṣāsaḥ r̥bhavaḥ mada cyutam śata kratum javanī sūnr̥tā ā aruhat
english: As aids the skilful R̥ibhus yearned to Indra strong to save, who fills mid-air, encompassed round with might, Rushing in rapture; and -o'er Ṣatakratu came the gladdening shout that urged him on to victory.

sanskrit: tvam gotram aṅgiraḥ bhyaḥ avr̥ṇoḥ apa uta atraye śata dureṣu gātu vit sasena cit vi madāya avahaḥ vasu ājau adrim vavasānasya nataryan
english: Thou hast disclosed the kine's stall for the Angirases, and made a way for Atri by a hundred doors. On Vimada thou hast bestowed both food and wealth, making thy bolt dance in the sacrificer's fight.

sanskrit: tvam apām api dhānā avr̥ṇoḥ apa adhāraya parvate dānu mat vasu vr̥tram yat indra śavasā avadhīḥ ahim āt it sūryam divi ā arohayaḥ dr̥śe
english: Thou hast unclosed the prisons of the waters; thou hast in the mountain seized the treasure rich in gifts. When thou hadst slain with might the dragon Vr̥itra, thou, Indra, didst raise the Sun in heaven for all to see.

sanskrit: tvam māyābhiḥ apa māyinaḥ adhamaḥ svadhābhiḥ ye adhi śuptau ajuhvata tvam piproḥ nr̥ manaḥ pra arujaḥ puraḥ pra r̥jiścānam dasyu hatyeṣu āvitha
english: With wondrous might thou blewest enchanter fiends away, with powers celestial those who called on thee in jest. Thou, hero-hearted, hast broken down Pipru's forts, and helped R̥ijiṣvan when the Dasyus were struck dead.

sanskrit: tvam kutsam śuṣṇa hatyeṣu āvitha arandhayaḥ atithi gvāya śambaram mahāntam cit arbudam ni kramīḥ padā sanāt eva dasyu hatyāya jajñiṣe
english: Thou savedst Kutsa when Ṣushṇa was smitten down; to Âtithigva gavest Ṣambara for a prey. E'en mighty Arbuda thou troddest under foot: thou from of old wast born to strike the Dasyus dead.

sanskrit: tve iti viśvā taviṣī sadhryak hitā tava rādhaḥ soma pīthāya harṣate tava vajraḥ cikite bāhvoḥ hitaḥ vr̥śca śatroḥ ava viśvāni vr̥ṣṇyā
english: All power and might is closely gathered up in thee; thy bounteous spirit joys in drinking Soma juice. Known is the thunderbolt that lies within thine arms: rend off therewith all manly prowess of our foe.

sanskrit: vi jānīhi āryān ye ca dasyavaḥ barhiṣmate randhaya śāsat avratān śākī bhava yajamānasya coditā viśvā it tā te sadha mādeṣu cākana
english: Discern thou well Aryas and Dasyus; punishing the lawless give them up to him whose grass is strewn. Be thou the sacrificer's strong encourager all these thy deeds are my delight at festivals.

sanskrit: anu vratāya randhayan apa vratān ābhūbhiḥ indraḥ śnathayan anābhuvaḥ vr̥ddhasya cit vardhataḥ dyām inakṣataḥ stavānaḥ vamraḥ vi jaghāna sam dihaḥ
english: Indra gives up the lawless to the pious man, destroying by the Strong Ones those who have no strength. Vamra when glorified destroyed the gathered piles of the still waxing great one who would reach the heaven.

sanskrit: takṣat yat te uśanā sahasā sahaḥ vi rodasī iti majmanā bādhate śavaḥ ā tvā vātasya nr̥ manaḥ manaḥ yujaḥ ā pūryamāṇam avahan abhi śravaḥ
english: The might which Uṣanâ hath formed for thee with might rends in its greatness and with strength both worlds apart. O Hero-souled, the steeds of Vâta, yoked by thought, have carried thee to fame while thou art filled with power.

sanskrit: mandiṣṭa yat uśane kāvye sacā indraḥ vaṅkūiti vaṅku tarā adhi tiṣṭhat i ugraḥ yayim niḥ apaḥ srotasā asr̥jat vi śuṣṇasya dr̥ṁhitāḥ airayat puraḥ
english: When Indra hath rejoiced with Kâvya Uṣanâ, he mounts his steeds who swerve wider and wider yet. The Strong hath loosed his bolt with the swift rush of rain, and he hath rent in pieces Ṣushṇa's firmbuilt forts.

sanskrit: ā sma ratham vr̥ṣa pāneṣu tiṣṭhasi śāryātasya pra bhr̥tāḥ yeṣu mandase indra yathā suta someṣu cākanaḥ anarvāṇam ślokam ā rohase divi
english: Thou mountest on thy car amid strong Soma draughts: Ṣâryâta brought thee those in which thou hast delight. Indra, when thou art pleased with men whose Soma flows thou risest to unchallenged glory in the sky.

sanskrit: adadāḥ arbhām mahate vacasyave kakṣīvate vr̥cayām indra sunvate menā abhavaḥ vr̥ṣaṇaśvasya sukrato itisu krato viśvā it tā te savaneṣu pra vācyā
english: To old Kaksivin, Soma-presser, skilled in song, O Indra, thou didst give the youthful Vr̥ichayâ. Thou, very wise, wast Menâ, Vrishaṇaṣva's child: those deeds of thine must all be told at Soma feasts.

sanskrit: indraḥ aśrāyi su dhyaḥ nireke pajreṣu stomaḥ duryaḥ na yūpaḥ aśva yuḥ gavyuḥ ratha yuḥ vasu yuḥ indraḥ it rāyaḥ kṣayati pra yantā
english: The good man's refuge in his need is Indra, firm as a doorpost, praised among the Pajras. Indra alone is Lord of wealth, the Giver, lover of riches, chariots, kine, and horses.

sanskrit: idam namaḥ vr̥ṣabhāya sva rāje satya śuṣmāya tavase avāci asmin indra vr̥jane sarva vīrāḥ smat sūri bhiḥ tava śarman syāma
english: To him the Mighty One, the self-resplendent, verily strong and great, this praise is uttered. May we and all the heroes, with the princes, be, in this fray, O Indra, in thy keeping.

sanskrit: tyam su meṣam mahaya svaḥ vidam śatam yasya su bhvaḥ sākam īrate atyam na vājam havana syadam ratham ā indram vavr̥tyām avase suvr̥kti bhiḥ
english: I GLORIFY that Ram who finds the light of heaven, whose hundred nobly-natured ones go forth with him. With hymns may I turn hither Indra to mine aid,– the Car which like a strong steed hasteth to the call.

sanskrit: saḥ parvataḥ na dharuṇeṣu acyutaḥ sahasram ūtiḥ taviṣīṣu vavr̥dhe indraḥ yat vr̥tram avadhīt nadī vr̥tam ubjan arṇāṁsi jarhr̥ṣāṇaḥ andhasā
english: Like as a mountain on firm basis, unremoved, he, thousandfold protector, waxed in mighty strength, When Indra, joying in the draughts of Soma juice, forced the clouds, slaying Vr̥itra stayer of their flow.

sanskrit: saḥ hi dvaraḥ dvariṣu vavraḥ ūdhani candra budhnaḥ mada vr̥ddhaḥ manīṣi bhiḥ indram tam ahve su apasyayā dhiyā maṁhiṣṭha rātim saḥ hi papriḥ andhasaḥ
english: For he stays e'en the stayers, spread o'er laden cloud, rooted in light, strengthened in rapture by the wise. Indra with thought, with skilled activity, I call, most liberal giver, for he sates him with the juice.

sanskrit: ā yam pr̥ṇanti divi sadma barhiṣaḥ samudram na su bhvaḥ svāḥ abhiṣṭayaḥ tam vr̥tra hatye anu tasthuḥ ūtayaḥ śuṣmāḥ indram avātāḥ ahruta psavaḥ
english: Whom those that flow in heaven on sacred grass, his own assistants, nobly-natured, fill full like the sea,– Beside that Indra when he smote down Vr̥itra stood his helpers, straight in form, mighty, invincible.

sanskrit: abhi sva vr̥ṣtim made asya yudhyataḥ raghvīḥ iva pravaṇe sasruḥ ūtayaḥ indraḥ yat vajrī dhr̥ṣamāṇaḥ andhasā bhinat valasya paridhīn iva tritaḥ
english: To him, as in wild joy he fought with him who stayed the rain, his helpers sped like swift streams down a slope, When Indra, thunder-armed, made bold by Soma draughts, as Trita cleaveth Vala's fences, cleft him through.

sanskrit: pari īm ghr̥ṇā carati titviṣe śavaḥ apaḥ vr̥tvī rajasaḥ budhnam ā aśayat vr̥trasya yat pravaṇe duḥ gr̥bhiśvanaḥ ni jaghantha hanvoḥ indra tanyatum
english: Splendour encompassed thee, forth shone thy warrior might: the rain-obstructer lay in mid-air's lowest deep, What time, O Indra, thou didst cast thy thunder down upon the jaws of Vritra hard to be restrained.

sanskrit: hradam na hi tvā ni r̥ṣanti ūrmayaḥ brahmāṇi indra tava yāni vardhanā tvaṣṭā cit te yujyam vavr̥dhe śavaḥ tatakṣa vajram abhibhūti ojasam
english: The hymns which magnify thee, Indra, reach to thee even as water-brooks flow down and fill the lake. Tvashṭar gave yet more force to thine appropriate strength, and forged thy thunderbolt of overpowering might.

sanskrit: jaghanvān oṁ iti hari bhiḥ sambhr̥takrato itisambhr̥ta krato indra vr̥tram manuṣe gātu yan apaḥ ayacchathāḥ bāhvoḥ vajram āyasam adhārayaḥ divi ā sūryam dr̥śe
english: When, Indra, thou whose power is linked with thy Bay Steeds hadst smitten Vr̥itra, causing floods to flow for man, Thou heldst in thine arms the metal thunderbolt, and settest in the heaven the Sun for all to see.

sanskrit: br̥hat sva candram ama vat yat ukthyam akr̥ṇvata bhiyasā rohaṇam di vaḥ yat mānuṣa pradhanāḥ indram ūtayaḥ svaḥ nr̥ ṣācaḥ marutaḥ amadan anu
english: In fear they raised the lofty self-resplendent hymn, praise giving and effectual, leading up to heaven, When Indra's helpers fighting for the good of men, the Maruts, faithful to mankind, joyed in the light.

sanskrit: dyauḥ cit asya ama vān aheḥ svanāt ayoyavīt bhiyasā vajraḥ indra te vr̥trasya yat badbadhānasya rodasī iti made sutasya śavasā abhinat śiraḥ
english: Then Heaven himself, the mighty, at that Dragon's roar reeled back in terror when, Indra, thy thunderbolt In the wild joy of Soma had struck off with might the head of Vr̥itra, tyrant of the earth and heaven.

sanskrit: yat it nu indra pr̥thivī daśa bhujiḥ ahāni viśvā tatananta kr̥ṣṭayaḥ atra aha te magha van vi śrutam sahaḥ dyām anu śavasā barhaṇā bhuvat
english: O Indra, were this earth extended forth tenfold, and men who dwell therein multiplied day by day, Still here thy conquering might, Maghavan, would be famed: it hath waxed vast as heaven in majesty and power.

sanskrit: tvam asya pāre rajasaḥ vi omanaḥ svabhūti ojāḥ avase dhr̥ṣat manaḥ cakr̥ṣe bhūmim prati mānam ojasaḥ apaḥ [svar iti] svaḥ pari bhūḥ eṣi ā divam
english: Thou, bold of heart, in thine own native might, for help, upon the limit of this mid-air and of heaven, Hast made the earth to be the pattern of thy strength: embracing flood and light thou reachest to the sky.

sanskrit: tvam bhuvaḥ prati mānam pr̥thivyāḥ r̥ṣva vīrasya br̥hataḥ patiḥ bhūḥ viśvam ā aprāḥ antarikṣam mahi tvā satyam addhā nakiḥ anyaḥ tvāvān
english: Thou art the counterpart of earth, the Master of lofty heaven with all its mighty Heroes: Thou hast filled all the region with thy greatness: yea, of a truth there is none other like thee.

sanskrit: na yasya dyāvāpr̥thivī iti anu vyacaḥ na sindhavaḥ rajasaḥ antam ānaśuḥ na uta sva vr̥ṣṭim made asya yudhyataḥ ekaḥ anyat cakr̥ṣe viśvam ānuṣak
english: Whose amplitude the heaven and earth have not attained, whose bounds the waters of mid-air have never reached,– Not, when in joy he fights the stayer of the rain: thou, and none else, hast made all things in order due.

sanskrit: ārcan atra marutaḥ sasmin ājau viśve devāsaḥ amadan anu tvā vr̥trasya yat bhr̥ṣṭi matā vadhena ni tvam indra prati ānam jaghantha
english: The Maruts sang thy praise in this encounter, and in thee all the Deities delighted, What time thou, Indra, with thy spiky weapon, thy deadly bolt, smotest the face of Vr̥itra.

sanskrit: ni oṁ iti su vācam pra mahe bharāmahe giraḥ indrāya sadane vivasvataḥ nu cit hi ratnam sasatām iva avidat na duḥ stutiḥ draviṇaḥ deṣu śasyate
english: WE will present fair praise unto the Mighty One, our hymns to Indra in Vivasvdn's dwelling-place; For he hath ne'er found wealth in those who seem to sleep: those who give wealth to men accept no paltry praise.

sanskrit: duraḥ aśvasya duraḥ indra goḥ asi duraḥ yavasya vasunaḥ inaḥ patiḥ śikṣānaraḥ pra divaḥ akāma karśanaḥ sakhā sakhi bhyaḥ tam idam gr̥ṇīmasi
english: Giver of horses, Indra, giver, thou, of kine, giver of barley, thou art Lord and guard of wealth: Man's helper from of old, not disappointing hope, Friend of our friends, to thee ,as such we sing this praise.

sanskrit: śacī vaḥ indra puru kr̥t dyumat tama tava it idam abhitaḥ cekite vasu ataḥ sam gr̥bhya abhi bhūte ā bhara mā tvāyataḥ jarituḥ kāmam ūnayīḥ
english: Indra, most splendid, powerful, rich in mighty deeds, this treasure spread around is known to be thine own. Gather therefrom, O Conqueror, and bring to us: fail not the hope of him who loves and sings to thee.

sanskrit: ebhiḥ dyubhiḥ su manāḥ ebhiḥ indu bhiḥ niḥ undhānaḥ amatim gobhiḥ aśvinā indreṇa dasyum darayantaḥ indu bhiḥ yuta dveṣasaḥ sam iṣā rabhemahi
english: Well pleased with these bright flames and with these Soma drops, take thou away our poverty with seeds and kine. With Indra scattering the Dasyu through these drops, freed from their hate may we obtain abundant food.

sanskrit: sam indra rāyā sam iṣā rabhemahi sam vājebhiḥ puru candraiḥ abhidyu bhiḥ sam devyā pra matyā vīra śuṣmayā go agrayā aśva vatyā rabhemahi
english: Let us obtain, O Indra, plenteous wealth and food, with strength exceeding glorious, shining to the sky: May we obtain the Goddess Providence, the strength of heroes, special source of cattle, rich in steeds.

sanskrit: te tvā madāḥ amadan tāni vr̥ṣṇyā te somāsaḥ vr̥tra hatyeṣu sat pate yat kārave daśa vr̥trāṇi aprati barhiṣmate ni sahasrāṇi barhayaḥ
english: These our libations strength-inspiring, Soma draughts, gladdened thee in the fight with Vr̥itra, Hero Lord, What time thou slewest for the singer with trimmed grass ten thousand Vr̥itras, thou resistless in thy might.

sanskrit: yudhā yudham upa gha it eṣi dhr̥śṇu yā purā puram sam idam haṁsi ojasā namyā yat indra sakhyā parāvati ni barhayaḥ namucm nāma māyinam
english: Thou goest on from fight to fight intrepidly, destroying castle after castle here with strength. Thou, Indra, with thy friend who makes the foe bow down, slewest from far away the guileful Namuci.

sanskrit: tvam karañjam uta parṇayam vadhīḥ tejiṣṭhayā atithi gvasya vartanī tvam śatā varṅgedasya abhinat puraḥ ananu daḥ pari sūtāḥ r̥jiśvanā
english: Thou hast struck down in death Karanja, Parṇaya, in Âtithigva's very glorious going forth. Unyielding, when R̥ijiṣvan compassed them with siege, thou hast destroyed the hundred forts of Vangr̥ida.

sanskrit: tvam etān jana rājñaḥ dviḥ daśa abandhunā su śravasā upa jagmuṣaḥ ṣaṣṭim sahasrā navatim nava śrutaḥ ni cakreṇa rathyā duḥ padā avr̥ṇak
english: With all-outstripping chariot-wheel, O Indra, thou far-famed, hast overthrown the twice ten Kings of men, With sixty thousand nine-and-ninety followers, who came in arms to fight with friendless Suṣravâs.

sanskrit: tvam āvitha su śravasam tava ūti bhiḥ tava trāma bhiḥ indra tūrvayāṇam tvam asmai kutsam atithi gvam āyum mahe rājñe yūne arandhanāyaḥ
english: Thou hast protected Suṣravâs with succour, and Tûrvayâṇa with thine aid, O Indra. Thou madest Kutsa, Âtithigva, Âyu, subject unto this King, the young, the mighty.

sanskrit: ye ut r̥ci indra deva gopāḥ sakhāyaḥ te śiva tamāḥ asāma tvām stoṣāma tvayā su vīrāḥ drāghīyaḥ āyuḥ pra taram dadhānāḥ
english: May we protected by the Gods hereafter remain thy very prosperous friends, O Indra. Thee we extol, enjoying through thy favour life long and joyful and with store of heroes.

sanskrit: mā naḥ asmin maghavan pr̥t su aṁhasi nahi te antaḥ śavasaḥ pari naśe akrandayaḥ nadyaḥ roruvat vanā kathā na kṣoṇīḥ bhiyasā sam ārata
english: URGE us not, Maghavan, to this distressful fight, for none may comprehend the limit of thy strength. Thou with fierce shout hast made the woods and rivers roar: did not men run in crowds together in their fear?

sanskrit: arca akrāya śākine śacī vate śr̥ṇvantam indram mahayan abhi stuhi yaḥ dhr̥ṣṇunā śavasā rodasī iti ubhe iti vr̥ṣā vr̥ṣa tvā vr̥ṣabhaḥ ni r̥ñjate
english: Sing hymns of praise to Ṣakra, Lord of power and might; laud thou and magnify Indra who hearcth thee, Who with his daring might, a Bull exceeding strong in strength, maketh him master of the heaven and earth.

sanskrit: arca dive br̥hate śūṣyam vacaḥ sva kṣatram yasya dhr̥ṣataḥ dhr̥ṣat manaḥ br̥hat śravāḥ asuraḥ barhaṇā kr̥taḥ puraḥ hari bhyām vr̥ṣabhaḥ rathaḥ hi saḥ
english: Sing forth to lofty Dyaus a strength-bestowing song, the Bold, whose resolute mind hath independent sway. High glory hath the Asura, compact of strength, drawn on by two Bay Steeds: a Bull, a Car is he.

sanskrit: tvam divaḥ br̥hataḥ sānu kopayaḥ ava tmanā dhr̥ṣatā śambaram bhinat yat māyinaḥ vrandinaḥ mandinā dhr̥ṣat śitām gabhastim aśanim pr̥tanyasi
english: The ridges of the lofty heaven thou madest shake; thou, daring, of thyself smotest through Ṣambara, When bold with gladdening juice, thou warredst with thy bolt, sharp and twoedged, against the banded sorcerers.

sanskrit: ni yat vr̥ṇakṣi śvasanasya mūrdhani śuṣṇasya cit vrandinaḥ roruvat vanā prācīnena manasā barhaṇāvatā yat adya cit kr̥ṇavaḥ kaḥ tvā pari
english: When with a roar that fills the woods, thou forcest down on wind's head the stores which 8usga kept confined, Who shall have power to stay thee firm and eager-souled from doing still this day what thou of old hast done?

sanskrit: tvam āvitha naryam turvaśam yadum tvam turvītim vayyam śatakrato itiśata krato tvam ratham etaśam kr̥tvye dhane tvam puraḥ navatim dambhayaḥ nava
english: Thou helpest Narya, Turvaṣa, and Yadu, and Vayya's son Turvîti, Ṣatakratu! Thou helpest horse and car in final battle thou breakest down the nine-and-ninety castles.

sanskrit: saḥ gha rājā sat patiḥ śūśuvat janaḥ rāta havyaḥ prati yaḥ śāsam invati ukthā vā yaḥ abhi gr̥ṇāti rādhasā dānuḥ asmai uparā pinvate d ivaḥ
english: A hero-lord is he, King of a mighty folk, who offers free oblations and promotes the Law, Who with a bounteous guerdon welcomes hymns of praise: for him flows down the abundant stream below the sky.

sanskrit: asamam kṣatram asamā manīṣā pra soma pāḥ apasā santu neme ye te indra daduṣaḥ vardhayanti mahi kṣatram sthaviram vr̥ṣṇyam ca
english: His power is matchless, matchless is his wisdom; chief, through their work, be some who drink the Soma, Those, Indra, who increase the lordly power, the firm heroic strength of thee the Giver.

sanskrit: tubhya it ete bahulāḥ adri dugdhāḥ camū sadaḥ camasāḥ indra pānāḥ vi aśnuhi tarpaya kāmam eṣām atha manaḥ vasu deyāya kr̥ṣva
english: Therefore for thee are these abundant beakers Indra's drink, stone-pressed juices held in ladles. Quaff them and satisfy therewith thy longing; then fix thy mind upon bestowing treasure.

sanskrit: apām atiṣṭhat dharuṇa hvaram tamaḥ antaḥ vr̥trasya jaṭhareṣu parvataḥ abhi īm indraḥ nadyaḥ vavriṇā hitāḥ viśvāḥ anu sthāḥ pravaṇeṣu jighnate
english: There darkness stood, the vault that stayed the waters' flow: in Vr̥itra's hollow side the rain-cloud lay concealed. But Indra smote the rivers which the obstructer stayed, flood following after flood, down steep declivitics.

sanskrit: saḥ śe vr̥dham adhi dhāḥ dyumnam asme iti mahi kṣatram janāṣāṭ indra tavyam rakṣa ca naḥ maghonaḥ pāh i sūrīn rāye ca naḥ su apatyai iṣe dhāḥ
english: So give us, Indra, bliss-increasing glory give us great sway and strength that conquers people. Preserve our wealthy patrons, save our princes; vouchsafe us wealth and food with noble offspring.

sanskrit: divaḥ cit asya varimā vi papratha indram na mahnā pr̥thivī cana prati bhīmaḥ tuviṣmān carṣaṇi bhyaḥ ātapaḥ śiśīte vajram tejase na vaṁsagaḥ
english: THOUGH e'en this heaven's wide space and earth have spread them out, nor heaven nor earth may be in greatness Indra's match. Awful and very mighty, causing woe to men, he whets his thunderbolt for sharpness, as a bull.

sanskrit: saḥ arṇavaḥ na nadyaḥ samudriyaḥ prati gr̥bhṇāti vi śritāḥ varīma bhiḥ indraḥ somasya pītaye vr̥ṣa yate sanāt saḥ yudhmaḥ ojasā panasyate
english: Like as the watery ocean, so doth he receive the rivers spread on all sides in their ample width. He bears him like a bull to drink of Soma juice, and will, as Warrior from of old, be praised for might.

sanskrit: tvam tam indra parvatam na bhojase mahaḥ nr̥mṇasya dharmaṇām irajyasi pra vīryeṇa devatāti cekite viśvasmai ugraḥ karmaṇe puraḥ h itaḥ
english: Thou swayest, Indra, all kinds of great manly power, so as to bend, as't were, even that famed mountain down. Foremost among the Gods is he through hero might, set in the van, the Strong One, for each arduous deed.

sanskrit: saḥ it vane namasyu bhiḥ vacasyate cāru janeṣu pra bruvāṇaḥ indri yam vr̥ṣā chanduḥ bhavati haryataḥ vr̥ṣā kṣemeṇa dhenām maghavā yat invati
english: He only in the wood is praised by worshippers, when he shows forth to men his own fair Indrapower. A friendly Bull is he, a Bull to be desired when Maghavan auspiciously sends forth his voice.

sanskrit: saḥ it mahāni sam ithāni majmanā kr̥ṇoti yudhmaḥ ojasā janebhyaḥ adha cana śrat dadhati tviṣi mate indrāya vajram ni ghanighnate vadham
english: Yet verily the Warrior in his vigorous strength stirreth up with his might great battles for mankind; And men have faith in Indra, the respIendent One, what time he hurleth down his bolt, his dart of death.

sanskrit: saḥ hi śravasyuḥ sadanāni kr̥trimā kṣmayā vr̥dhānaḥ ojasā vi nāśayan jyotīṁṣi kr̥ṇvan avr̥kāṇi yajyave ava su kratuḥ sartavai apaḥ sr̥jat
english: Though, fain for glory, and with strength increased on earth, he with great might destroys the dwellings made with art, He makes the lights of heaven shine forth secure, he bids, exceeding wise, the floods flow for his worshipper.

sanskrit: dānāya manaḥ soma pāvan astu te arvāñcā harī iti vandana śrut ā kr̥dhi yamiṣṭhāsaḥ sārathayaḥ ye indrca te na tvā ketāḥ ā dabhnuvanti bhūrṇayaḥ
english: Drinker of Soma, let thy heart incline to give; bring thy Bays hitherward, O thou who hearest praise. Those charioteers of' thine, best skilled to draw the rein, the rapid sunbeams, Indra, lead thee not astray.

sanskrit: apra kṣitam vasu bibharṣi hastayoḥ aṣāl̥ham sahaḥ tanvi sr̥utaḥ dadhe āvr̥tāsaḥ avatāsaḥ na kartr̥ bhiḥ tanūṣu te kratavaḥ indra bhūrayaḥ
english: Thou bearest in both hands treasure that never fails; the famed One in his body holds unvanquished might. O Indra, in thy members many powers abide, like wells surrounded by the ministering priests.

sanskrit: eṣaḥ pra pūrvīḥ ava tasya camriṣaḥ atyaḥ na yoṣām ut ayaṁsta bhurvaṇiḥ dakṣam mahe pāyayate hiraṇyayam ratham āvr̥tya hari yogam r̥bhvasam
english: FOR this man's full libations held in ladles, he hath roused him, eager, as a horse to meet the mare. He stays his golden car, yoked with Bay Horses, swift, and drinks the Soma juice which strengthens for great deeds.

sanskrit: tam gūrtayaḥ neman iṣaḥ parīṇasaḥ samudram na sam caraṇe san iṣyavaḥ patim dakṣasya vidathasya nu sahāḥ girim na venāḥ adhi roha tejasā
english: To him the guidance-following songs of praise flow full, as those who seek gain go in company to the flood. To him the Lord of power, the holy synod's might, as to a hill, with speed, ascend the loving ones.

sanskrit: saḥ turvaṇiḥ mahān areṇu paiṁsye gireḥ bhr̥ṣṭiḥ na bhrājate tujā śavaḥ yena śuṣṇam māyinam āyasaḥ made dudhraḥ ābhūṣu rāmayat ni dāman i
english: Victorious, great is he; in manly battle shines, unstained with dust, his might, as shines a mountain peak; Wherewith the iron one, fierce e'en against the strong, in rapture, fettered wily Sushna fast in bonds.

sanskrit: devī yadi taviṣī tvāvr̥dhā ūtaye indram siṣakti uṣasam na sūryaḥ yaḥ dhr̥ṣṇunā śavasā bādhate tamaḥ iyarti reṇum br̥hat arhari svani ḥ
english: When Strength the Goddess, made more strong for help by thee, waits upon Indra as the Sun attends the Dawn, Then. he who with his might unflinching kills the gloom stirs up the dust aloft, with joy and triumphing.

sanskrit: vi yat tiraḥ dharuṇam acyutam rajaḥ atisthipaḥ divaḥ ātāsu barhaṇā svaḥ mīl̥he yat made indra harṣyā ahan vr̥tram niḥ apām aubjaḥ arṇavam
english: When thou with might, upon the framework of the heaven, didst fix, across, air's region firmly, unremoved, In the light-winning war, Indra, in rapturous joy, thou smotest Vr̥itra dead and broughtest floods of rain.

sanskrit: tvam divaḥ dharuṇam dhiṣe ojasā pr̥thivyāḥ indra sadaneṣu māhinaḥ tvam sutasya made ariṇāḥ apaḥ vi vr̥trasya samayā pāṣyā arujaḥ
english: Thou with thy might didst grasp,the holder-up of heaven, thou who art mighty also in the seats of earth. Thou, gladdened by the juice, hast set the waters free, and broken Vr̥itra's stony fences through and through.

sanskrit: pra maṁhiṣṭhāya br̥hate br̥hat raye satya śuṣmāya tavase matim bhare apām iva pravaṇe yasya duḥ dharam rādhaḥ viśva āyu śavase apa vr̥tam
english: To him most liberal, lofty Lord of lofty wealth, verily powerful and strong, I bring my hymn,– Whose checkless bounty, as of waters down a slope, is spread abroad for all that live, to give them strength.

sanskrit: agha te viśvam anu ha asat iṣṭaye āpaḥ nimnāiva savanā haviṣmataḥ yat parvate na sam aśīta haryataḥ indrasya vajraḥ śnathitā hiraṇyayaḥ
english: Now all this world, for worship, shall come after thee-the offerer's libations like floods to the depth, When the well-loved one seems to rest upon the hill, the thunderbolt of Indra, shatterer wrought of gold.

sanskrit: asmai bhīmāya namasā sam adhvare uṣaḥ na śubhre ā bhara panīyase yasya dhāma śravase nāma indriyam jyotiḥ akāri haritaḥ na ayase
english: To him the terrible, most meet for lofty praise, like bright Dawn, now bring gifts with reverence in this rite, Whose being, for renown, yea, Indra-power and light, have been created, like bay steeds, to move with speed.

sanskrit: ime te indra te vayam puru stuta ye tvā ārabhya carāmasi prabhuvaso itiprabhu vaso nahi tvat anyaḥ girvaṇaḥ giraḥ saghat kṣoṇīḥ iva prati naḥ harya tat vacaḥ
english: Thine, Indra, praised by many, excellently rich! are we who trusting in thy help draw near to thee. Lover of praise, none else but thou receives our laud: as earth loves all her creatures, love thou this our hymn.

sanskrit: bhūri te indra vīryam tava smasi asya stotuḥ magha van kāmam ā pr̥ṇa anu te dyauḥ br̥hatī vīryam mame iyam ca te pr̥thivī neme ojase
english: Great is thy power, O Indra, we are thine. Fulfil, O Maghavan, the wish of this thy worshipper. After thee lofty heaven hath measured out its strength: to thee and to thy power this earth hath bowed itself.

sanskrit: tvam tam indra parvatam mahām urum vajreṇa vajrin parva śaḥ cakartitha ava asr̥jaḥ ni vr̥tāḥ sartavai apaḥ satrā viśvam dadhiṣe kevalam sahaḥ
english: Thou, who hast thunder for thy weapon, with thy bolt hast shattered into pieces this broad massive cloud. Thou hast sent down the obstructed floods that they may flow: thou hast, thine own for ever, all victorious might.

sanskrit: nu cit sahaḥ jāḥ amr̥taḥ ni tundate hotā yat dūtaḥ abhavat vivasvataḥ vi sādhiṣṭhebhiḥ pathi bhiḥ rajaḥ mame ā deva tātā haviṣā vivāsati
english: NE'ER waxeth faint the Immortal, Son of Strength, since he, the Herald, hath become Vivasvan's messenger.

sanskrit: ā svam adma yuvamānaḥ ajaraḥ tr̥ṣu aviṣyan ataseṣu tiṣṭhati atyaḥ na pr̥ṣṭham pruṣitasya rocate divaḥ na sānu stanayan acikradat
english: Never decaying, seizing his appropriate food, rapidly, eagerly through the dry wood he spreads. His back, as he is sprinkled, glistens like a horse: loud hath he roared and shouted like the heights of heaven?

sanskrit: kroṇā rudrebhiḥ vasu bhiḥ puraḥ hitaḥ hotā ni sattaḥ rayiṣāṭ amatyarḥ rathaḥ na vikṣu r̥ñjasānaḥ āyuṣu vi ānuṣak vāryā devaḥ r̥ṇvati
english: Set high in place o'er all that Vasus, Rudras do, immortal, Lord of riches, seated as High Priest; Hastening like a car to men, to those who live, the God without delay gives boons to be desired.

sanskrit: vi vāta jūtaḥ ataseṣu tiṣṭhate vr̥thā juhūbhiḥ sr̥ṇyā tuvi svaṇiḥ tr̥ṣu yat agne vaninaḥ vr̥ṣa yase kr̥ṣṇam te ema ruśat ūrme ajara
english: Urged by the wind be spreads through dry wood as he lists, armed with his tongues for sickles, with a mighty roar. Black is thy path, Agni, changeless, with glittering waves! when like a bull thou rushest eager to the trees.

sanskrit: tapuḥ jambhaḥ vane ā vāta coditaḥ yūthe na sāhvān ava vāti vaṁsagaḥ abhi vrajan akṣitam pājasā rajaḥ sthātuḥ caratham bhayate patatri ṇaḥ
english: With teeth of flame, wind-driven, through the wood he speeds, triumphant like a bull among the herd of cows, With bright strength roaming to the everlasting air: things fixed, things moving quake before him as he flies.

sanskrit: dadhuḥ tvā bhr̥gavaḥ mānuṣeṣu ā rayim na cārum su havam janebhyaḥ hotāram agne atithim vareṇyam mitram na śevam divyāya janmane
english: The Bhr̥igus established thee among mankind for men, like as a treasure, beauteous, easy to invoke; Thee, Agni, as a herald and choice-worthy guest, as an auspicious Friend to the Celestial Race.

sanskrit: hotāram sapta juhvaḥ yajiṣṭham yam vāghataḥ vr̥ṇate adhvareṣu agnim viśveṣām aratim vasūnām saparyāmi prayasā yāmi ratnam
english: Agni, the seven tongues' deftest Sacrificer, him whom the priests elect at solemn worship, The Herald, messenger of all the Vasus, I serve with dainty food, I ask for riches.

sanskrit: acchidrā sūno iti sahasaḥ naḥ adya stotr̥ bhyaḥ mitra mahaḥ śarma yaccha agne gr̥ṇantam aṁhasaḥ uruṣya ūrjaḥ napāt pūḥ bhiḥ āyasībhiḥ
english: Grant, Son of Strength, thou rich in friends, a refuge without a flaw this day to us thy praisers. O Agni, Son of Strength, with forts of iron preserve thou from distress the man who lauds thee.

sanskrit: bhava varūtham gr̥ṇate vibhāvaḥ bhava maghavan maghavat bhyaḥ śarma uruṣya agne aṁhasaḥ gr̥ṇantam prātaḥ makṣu dhiyāvasuḥ jagamyāt
english: Be thou a refuge, Bright One, to the singer, a shelter, Bounteous Lord, to those who worship. Preserve the singer from distress, O Agni. May he, enriched with prayer, come soon and early.

sanskrit: vayāḥ it agne agnayaḥ te anye tve iti viśve amr̥tāḥ mādayante vaiśvānara nābhiḥ asi kṣitīnām sthūṇāiva janān upa mit yayantha
english: THE other fires are, verily, thy branches; the Immortals all rejoice in thee, O Agni. Centre art thou, Vaigvdnara, of the people, sustaining men like a deep-founded pillar.

sanskrit: mūrdhā divaḥ nābhiḥ agniḥ pr̥thivyāḥ atha abhavat aratiḥ rodasyoḥ tam tvā devāsaḥ ajanayanta devam vaiśvānara jyotiḥ it āryāya
english: The forehead of the sky, earth's centre, Agni became the messenger of earth and heaven. Vaiṣvânara, the Deities produced thee, a God, to be a light unto the Ârya.

sanskrit: ā sūrye na raśmayaḥ dhruvāsaḥ vaiśvānare dadhire agnā vasūni yā parvateṣu oṣadhīṣu ap su yā mānuṣeṣu asi tasya rājā
english: As in the Sun firm rays are set for ever, treasures are in Vaiṣvânara, in Agni. Of all the riches in the hills, the waters, the herbs, among mankind, thou art the Sovran.

sanskrit: br̥hatīivetibr̥hatī iva sūnave rodasī iti giraḥ hotā manuṣyaḥ na dakṣaḥ svaḥ vate satya śuṣmāya pūvīrḥ vaiśvānarāya nr̥ tamāya yahvīḥ
english: As the great World-halves, so are their Son's praises; skilled, as a man, to act, is he the Herald. Vaiṣvânara, celestial, truly mighty, most manly One, hath many a youthful consort.

sanskrit: divaḥ cit te br̥hataḥ jāta vedaḥ vaiśvānara pra ririce mahi tvam rājā kr̥ṣṭīnām asi mānuṣīṇām yudhā devebhyaḥ varivaḥ cakartha
english: Even the lofty heaven, O Jâtavedas Vaiṣvânara, hath not attained thy greatness. Thou art the King of lands where men are settled, thou hast brought comfort to the Gods in battle.

sanskrit: pra nu mahi tvam vr̥ṣabhasya vocam yam pūravaḥ vr̥tra hanam sacante vaiśvānaraḥ dasyum agniḥ jaghanvān adhūnot kāṣṭhāḥ ava śambaram bhet
english: Now will I tell the greatness of the Hero whom Prarti's sons follow as Vr̥itra's slayer: Agni Vaiṣvânara struck down the Dasyu, cleave Ṣambara through and shattered down his fences.

sanskrit: vaiśvānaraḥ mahimnā viśva kr̥ṣṭiḥ bharat vājeṣu yajataḥ vibhāvā śāta vaneye śatinībhiḥ agniḥ puru nīthe jarate sūnr̥tāvān
english: Vaiṣvânara, dwelling by his might with all men, far-shining, holy mid the Bharadvâjas, Is lauded, excellent, with hundred praises by Purunîtha, son of Ṣatavani.

sanskrit: vahnim yaśasam vidathasya ketum supra avyam dūtam sadyaḥ artham dvi janmānam rayim iva pra śastam rātim bharat bhr̥gave mātariśvā
english: As 'twere Some goodly treasure Mâtariṣvan brought, as a gift, the glorious Priest to Bhr̥igu, Banner of sacrifice, the good Protector, child of two births, the swiftly moving envoy.

sanskrit: asya śāsuḥ ubhayāsaḥ sacante haviṣmantaḥ uśijaḥ ye ca martāḥ d ivaḥ cit pūrvaḥ ni asādi hotā āpr̥cchyaḥ viśpatiḥ vikṣu vedhāḥ
english: Both Gods and men obey this Ruler's order, Gods who are worshipped, men who yearn and worship. As Priest he takes his seat ere break of morning, House-Lord, adorable with men, Ordainer.

sanskrit: tam navyasī hr̥daḥ ā jāyamānam asmat su kīrtiḥ madhu jihvam aśyāḥ yam r̥tvijaḥ vr̥jane mānuṣāsaḥ prayasvantaḥ āyavaḥ jījananta
english: May our fair praise, heart-born, most recent, reach him whose tongue, e'en at his birth, is sweet as honey; Whom mortal priests, men, with their strong endeavour, supplied with dainty viands, have created.

sanskrit: uśik pāvakaḥ vasuḥ mānuṣeṣu vareṇyaḥ hotā adhāyi vikṣu damūnā gr̥ha patiḥ dame ā agniḥ bhuvat rayi patiḥ rayīṇām
english: Good to mankind, the yearning Purifier hath among men been placed as Priest choice-worthy. May Agni be our Friend, Lord of the Household, protector of the riches in the dwelling.

sanskrit: tam tvā vayam patim agne rayīṇām pra śaṁsāmaḥ mati bhiḥ gotamāsaḥ āśum na vājam bharam marjayantaḥ prātaḥ makṣu dhiyāvasuḥ jagamyāt
english: As such we Gotamas with hymns extol thee, O Agni, as the guardian Lord of riches, Decking thee like a horse, the swift prizewinner. May he, enriched with prayer, come soon and early.

sanskrit: asmai it oṁ iti pra tavase turāya prayaḥ na harmi stomam māhināya r̥cīṣamāya adhri gave oham indrāya brahmāṇi rāta tamā
english: EVEN to him, swift, strong and high. exalted, I bring my song of praise as dainty viands, My thought to him resistless, praise-deserving, prayers offered most especially to Indra.

sanskrit: asmai it oṁ iti prayaḥ iva pra yaṁsi bharāmi āṅgūṣam bādhe su vr̥kti indrāya hr̥dā manasā manīṣā pratnāya patye dhiyaḥ marjayanta
english: Praise, like oblation, I present, and utter aloud my song, my fair hymn to the Victor. For Indra, who is Lord of old, the singers have decked their lauds with heart and mind and spirit.

sanskrit: asmai it oṁ iti tyam upa mam svaḥ sām bharāmi āṅgūṣam āsyena maṁhiṣṭham acchokti bhiḥ matīnām suvr̥kti bhiḥ sūrim vavr̥dhadhyai
english: To him then with my lips mine adoration, winning heaven's light, most excellent, I offer, To magnify with songs of invocation and with fair hymns the Lord, most bounteous Giver.

sanskrit: asmai it oṁ iti stomam sam hinomi ratham na taṣṭāiva tat sināya giraḥ ca girvāhase su vr̥kti indrāya viśvam invam medhirāya
english: Even for him I frame a laud, as fashions the wright a chariot for the man who needs it,– Praises to him who gladly hears our praises, a hymn well-formed, all-moving, to wise Indra.

sanskrit: asmai it oṁ iti saptim iva śravasyā indrāya arkam juhvā sam añje vīram dāna okasam vandadhyai purām gūrta śravasam darmāṇam
english: So with my tongue I deck, to please that Indra, my hymn, as 'twere a horse, through love of glory, To reverence the Hero, bounteous Giver, famed far and wide, destroyer of the castles.

sanskrit: iti tvaṣṭā takṣat vajram svapaḥ tamam svaryam raṇāya vr̥trasya cit vidat yena marma tujan īśānaḥ tujatā kiyedhāḥ
english: Even for him hath Tvashṭar forged the thunder, most deftly wrought, celestial, for the battle, Wherewith he reached the vital parts of Vr̥itra, striking-the vast, the mighty with the striker.

sanskrit: asya it oṁ iti mātuḥ savaneṣu sadyaḥ mahaḥ pitum papivān cāru annā muṣāyat viṣṇuḥ pacatam sahīyān vidhyat varāham tiraḥ adrim astā
english: As soon as, at libations of his mother, great Vishṇu had drunk up the draught, he plundered. The dainty cates, the cooked mess; but One stronger transfixed the wild boar, shooting through the mountain.

sanskrit: asmai it oṁ iti gnāḥ cit deva patnīḥ indrāya arkam ahi hatye ūvur ity ūvuḥ pari dyāvāpr̥thivī iti jabhre urvī iti na asya te iti mahimānam pari staitistaḥ
english: To him, to Indra, when he slew the Dragon, the Dames, too, Consorts of the Goda, wove praises. The mighty heaven and earth hath he encompassed: thy greatness heaven and earth, combined, exceed not.

sanskrit: asya it eva pra ririce mahitvam divaḥ pr̥thivyāḥ pari antarikṣāt sva rāṭ indraḥ dame ā viśva gūrtaḥ su ariḥ amatraḥ vavakṣe raṇāya
english: Yea, of a truth, his magnitude surpasseth the magnitude of earth, mid-air, and heaven. Indra, approved by all men, self-resplendent, waxed in his home, loud-voiced and strong for battle.

sanskrit: asya it eva śavasā śuṣantam vi vr̥ścat vajreṇa vr̥tram indraḥ gāḥ na vrāṇāḥ avanīḥ amuñcat abhi śravaḥ dāvane sa cetāḥ
english: Through his own strength Indra with bolt of thunder cut piece-meal Vr̥itra, drier up of waters. He let the floods go free, like cows imprisoned, for glory, with a heart inclined to bounty.

sanskrit: asya it oṁ iti tveṣasā ranta sindhavaḥ pari yat vajreṇa sīm ayacchat īśāna kr̥t dāśuṣe daśasyan turvītaye gādham turvaṇiḥ karitikaḥ
english: The rivers played, through his impetuous splendour, since with his bolt he compassed them on all sides. Using his might and favouring him who worshipped, he made a ford, victorious, for Turvîti.

sanskrit: asmai it oṁ iti pra bhara tūtujānaḥ vr̥trāya vajram īśānaḥ kiyedhāḥ goḥ na parva vi rada tiraścā iṣyan arṇāṁsi apām caradhyai
english: Vast, with thine ample power, with eager movement, against this Vr̥itra cast thy bolt of thunder. Rend thou his joints, as of an ox, dissevered, with bolt oblique, that floods of rain may follow.

sanskrit: asya it oṁ iti pra brūhi pūrvyāṇi turasya karmāṇi navyaḥ ukthaiḥ yudhe yat iṣṇānaḥ āyudhāni r̥ghāyamāṇaḥ ni riṇāti śatrūn
english: Sing with new lauds his exploits wrought aforetime, the deeds of him, yea, him who moveth swiftly, When, hurling forth his weapons in the battle, he with impetuous wrath lays low the foemen.

sanskrit: asya it oṁ iti bhiyā girayaḥ ca dr̥l̥hāḥ dyāvā ca bhūmā januṣaḥ tujeteiti upo iti venasya joguvānaḥ oṇim sadyaḥ bhuvat vīryāya nodhāḥ
english: When he, yea, he, comes forth the firm. Set mountains and the whole heaven and earth, tremble for terror. May Nodhas, ever praising the protection of that dear Friend, gain quickly strength heroic.

sanskrit: asmai it oṁ iti tyat anu dāyi eṣām ekaḥ yat vavne bhūreḥ īśānaḥ pra etaśam sūrye paspr̥dhānam sauvaśvye suṣvim āvat indraḥ
english: Now unto him of these things hath been given what he who rules alone o'er much, electeth. Indra hath helped Etaṣa, Soma-presser, contending in the race of steeds with Sarya.

sanskrit: eva te hāri yojana su vr̥kti indra brahmāṇi gotamāsaḥ akran ā eṣu viśva peśasam dhiyam dhāḥ prātaḥ makṣu dhiyāvasuḥ jagamyāt
english: Thus to thee, Indra, yoker of Bay Coursers, the Gotamas have brought their prayers to please thee. Bestow upon them thought, decked with all beauty. May he, enriched with prayer, come soon and early.

sanskrit: pra manmahe śavasānāya śūṣam āṅgūṣam girvaṇase aṅgirasvat suvr̥kt i bhiḥ stuvate r̥gmiyāya arcāma arkam nare vi śrutāya
english: LIKE Angiras a gladdening laud we ponder to him who loveth song, exceeding mighty. Let us sing glory to the far-famed Hero who must be praised with fair hymns by the singer.

sanskrit: pra vaḥ mahe mahi namaḥ bharadhvam āṅgūṣyam śavasānāya sāma yena naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ pada jñāḥ arcantaḥ aṅgirasaḥ gāḥ avindan
english: Unto the great bring ye great adoration, a chant with praise to him exceeding mighty, Through whom our sires, Angirases, singing praises and knowing well the places, found the cattle.

sanskrit: indrasya aṅgirasām ca iṣṭau vidat saramā tanayāya dhāsim br̥haspatiḥ bhinat adrim vidat gāḥ sam usriyābhiḥ vāvaśanta naraḥ
english: When Indra and the Angirases desired it, Saramâ found provision for her offspring. Br̥ihaspati cleft the mountain, found the cattle: the heroes shouted with the kine in triumph.

sanskrit: saḥ su stubhā saḥ stubhā sapta vipraiḥ svareṇa adrim svaryaḥ nava gvaiḥ saraṇyu bhiḥ phali gam indra śakra valam raveṇa daśa gvaiḥ
english: Mid shout, loud shout, and roar, with the Navagvas, seven singers, hast thou, heavenly, rent the mountain; Thou hast, with speeders, with Daṣagvas, Indra, Ṣakra, with thunder rent obstructive Vala.

sanskrit: gr̥ṇānaḥ aṅgiraḥ bhiḥ dasma vi vaḥ uṣasā sūryeṇa gobhiḥ andhaḥ vi bhūmyāḥ aprathayaḥ indra sānu divaḥ rajaḥ uparam astabhāyaḥ
english: Praised by Angirases, thou, foe-destroyer, hast, with the Dawn, Sun, rays, dispellcd the darkness. Thou Indra, hast spread out the earths high ridges, and firmly fixed the region under heaven.

sanskrit: tat oṁ iti prayakṣa tamam asya karma dasmasya cāru tamam asti daṁsaḥ upa hvare yat uparāḥ apinvat madhu arṇasaḥ nadyaḥ catasraḥ
english: This is the deed most worthy of all honour, the fairest marvel of the Wonder-Worker, That, nigh where heaven bends down, he made four rivers flow full with waves that carry down sweet water.

sanskrit: dvitā vi vavre sa najā sanīl̥e itisa nīl̥e ayāsyaḥ stavamānebhiḥ arkaiḥ bhagaḥ na meneiti parame vi oman adhārayat rodasī iti su daṁsāḥ
english: Unwearied, won with lauding hymns, he parted of old the ancient Pair, united ever. In highest sky like Bhaga, he the doer of marvels set both Dames and earth and heaven.

sanskrit: sanāt divam pari bhūma virūpeitivi rūpe punaḥ bhuvā yuvatī iti svebhiḥ evaiḥ kr̥ṣṇebhiḥ aktā uṣāḥ ruśat bhiḥ vapuḥ bhiḥ ā carataḥ anyāanyā
english: Still born afresh, young Dames, each in her manner, unlike in hue, the Pair in alternation Round heaven and earth from ancient time have travelled, Night with her dark limbs, Dawn with limbs of splendour.

sanskrit: sanemi sakhyam su apasyamānaḥ sūnuḥ dādhāra śavasā su daṁsāḥ āmāsu cit dadhiṣe pakvam antariti payaḥ kr̥ṣṇāsu ruśat rohiṇīṣu
english: Rich in good actions, skilled in operation, the Son with might maintains his perfect friendship. Thou in the raw cows, black of hue or ruddy, storest the ripe milk glossy white in colour.

sanskrit: sanāt sa nīl̥āḥ avanīḥ avātāḥ vratā rakṣante amr̥tāḥ sahaḥ bhiḥ puru sahasrā janayaḥ na patnīḥ duvasyanti svasāraḥ ahrayāṇam
english: Their paths, of old connected, rest uninjured; they with great might preserve the immortal statutes. For many thousand holy works the Sisters wait on the haughty Lord like wives and matrons.

sanskrit: sanāyuvaḥ namasā navyaḥ arkaiḥ vasu yavaḥ matayaḥ dasma dadruḥ patim na patnīḥ uśatīḥ uśantam spr̥śanti tvā śavasāvan manīṣāḥ
english: Thoughts ancient, seeking wealth, with adoration, with newest lauds have sped to thee, O Mighty. As yearning wives cleave to their yearning husband, so cleave our hymns to thee, O Lord most potent.

sanskrit: sanāt eva tava rāyaḥ gabhastau na kṣīyante na upa dasyanti dasma dyumān asi kratu mān indra dhīraḥ śikṣa śacī vaḥ tava naḥ śacībhiḥ
english: Strong God, the riches which thy hands have holden from days of old have perished not nor wasted. Splendid art thou, O Indra, wise, unbending:strengthen us with might, O Lord of Power.

sanskrit: sanāyate gotamaḥ indra navyam atakṣat brahma hari yojanāya su nīthāya naḥ śavasāna nodhāḥ prātaḥ makṣu dhiyāvasuḥ jagamyāt
english: O mighty Indra, Gotama's son Nodhas hath fashioned this new prayer to thee Eternal, Sure leader, yoker of the Tawny Coursers. May he, enriched with prayer, come soon and early.

sanskrit: tvam mahān indra yaḥ ha śuṣmaiḥ dyāvā jajñānaḥ pr̥thivī iti ame ghāḥ yat ha te viśvā girayaḥ cit abhvā bhiyā dr̥l̥hāsaḥ kiraṇāḥ na aijan
english: THOU art the Mighty One; when born, O Indra, with power thou tcrrifiedst earth and heaven – When, in their fear of thee, all firm-set mountains and monstrous creatures shook like dust before thee.

sanskrit: ā yat harī iti indra vi vratā veḥ ā te vajram jaritā bāhvoḥ dhāt yena aviharyatakrato ity aviharyata krato amitrān puraḥ iṣṇāsi puru hūta pūrvīḥ
english: When thy two wandering Bays thou drawest hither, thy praiser laid within thine arms the thunder, Wherewith, O Much-invoked, in will resistless, thou smitest foemen down and many a castle.

sanskrit: vr̥jane pr̥kṣe āṇau yūne kutsāya dyumate sacā ahan
english: Faithful art thou, these thou defiest, Indra; thou art the R̥ibhus' Lord, heroic, victor. Thou, by his side, for young and glorious Kutsa, with steed and car in battle slewest Ṣushṇa,

sanskrit: tvam ha tyat indra codīḥ sakhā vr̥tram yat vajrin vr̥ṣa karman ubhnāḥ yat ha śūra vr̥ṣa maṇaḥ parācaiḥ vi dasyūn yonau akr̥taḥ vr̥thāṣāṭ
english: That, as a friend, thou furtheredst, O Indra, when, Thunderer, strong in act, thou crushedst Vr̥itra; When, Hero, thou, great-souled, with easy conquest didst rend the Dasyus in their distant dwelling.

sanskrit: tvam ha tyat indra ariṣaṇyan dr̥l̥hasya cit martānām ajuṣṭau vi asmat ā kāṣṭhāḥ arvate vaḥ ghanāiva vajrin śnathihi amitrān
english: This doest thou, and art not harmed, O Indra, e'en in the anger of the strongest mortal. Lay thou the race-course open for our horses: as with a club, slay, Thunderarmed! our foemen.

sanskrit: tvām ha tyat indra arṇa sātau svaḥ mīl̥he naraḥ ājā havante tava svadhāvaḥ iyam ā sa marye ūtiḥ vājeṣu atasāyyā bhūt
english: Hence men invoke thee, Indra, in the tumult of battle, in the light-bestowing conflict. This aid of thine, O Godlike One, was ever to be implored in deeds of might in combat.

sanskrit: tvam ha tyat indra sapta yudhyan puraḥ vajrin puru kutsāya dardaḥ barhiḥ na yat su dāse vr̥thā varka aṁhoḥ rājan varivaḥ pūrave kaḥ
english: Warring for Pûrukutsa thou, O Indra, Thunder-armed I breakest down the seven castles; Easily, for Sudis, like grass didst rend them, and out of need, King, broughtest gain to Pûru.

sanskrit: tvam tyām naḥ indra deva citrām iṣam āpaḥ na pīpayaḥ pari jman yayā śūra prati asmabhyam yaṁsi tmanam ūrjam na viśvadha kṣaradhyai
english: O Indra, God who movest round about us, feed us with varied food plenteous as water- Food wherewithal, O Hero, thou bestowest vigour itself to flow to us for ever.

sanskrit: akāri te indra gotamebhiḥ brahmāṇi āuktā namasā hari bhyām su peśasam vājam ā bhara naḥ prātaḥ makṣu dhiyāvasuḥ jagamyāt
english: Prayers have been made by Gotamas, O Indra, addressed to thee, with laud for thy Bay Horses. Bring us in noble shape abundant riches. May he, enriched with prayer, come soon and early.

sanskrit: vr̥ṣṇe śardhāya su makhāya vedhase nodhaḥ su vr̥ktim pra bhara marut bhyaḥ apaḥ na dhīraḥ manasā su hastyaḥ giraḥ sam añje vidatheṣu ābhuvaḥ
english: BRING for the manly host, wise and majestical, O Nodhas, for the Maruts bring thou a pure gift. I deck my songs as one deft-handed, wise in mind prepares the water that hath power in solemn rites.

sanskrit: te jajñire divaḥ r̥ṣvāsaḥ ukṣaṇaḥ rudrasya maryā asurāḥ arepasaḥ pāvakāsaḥ śucayaḥ sūryāḥ iva satvānaḥ na drapsinaḥ ghora varpasaḥ
english: They spring to birth, the lofty Ones, the Bulls of Heaven, divine, the youths of Rudra, free from spot and stain; The purifiers, shining brightly even as suns, awful of form like giants, scattering rain-drops down.

sanskrit: yuvānaḥ rudrāḥ ajarāḥ abhok hanaḥ vavakṣuḥ adhri gāvaḥ parvatāḥ iva dr̥l̥hā cit viśvā bhuvanāni pārthivā pra cyāvayanti divyāni majmanā
english: Young Rudras, demon-slayers, never growing old, they have waxed, even as mountains, irresistible. They make all beings tremble with their mighty strength, even the very strongest, both of earth and heaven.

sanskrit: citraiḥ añji bhiḥ vapuṣe vi añjate vakṣaḥ su rukmān adhi yetire śubhe aṁseṣu eṣām ni mimr̥kṣuḥ r̥ṣṭayaḥ sākam jajñire svadhayā divaḥ naraḥ
english: With glittering ornaments they deck them forth for show; for beauty on their breasts they bind their chains of gold. The lances on their shoulders pound to pieces; they were born together, of themselves, the Men of Heaven.

sanskrit: īśāna kr̥taḥ dhunayaḥ riśādasaḥ vātān vi dyutaḥ taviṣībhiḥ akrata duhanti ūdhaḥ divyāni dhūtayaḥ bhūmim pinvanti payasā pari jrayaḥ
english: Loud roarers, giving strength, devourers of the foe, they make the winds, they make the lightnings with their powers. The restless shakers drain the udders of the sky, and ever wandering round fill the earth full with milk.

sanskrit: pinvanti apaḥ marutaḥ su dānavaḥ payaḥ ghr̥ta vat vidatheṣu ābhuvaḥ atyam na mihe vi nayanti vājinam utsam duhanti stanayantam akṣitam
english: The bounteous Maruts with the fatness dropping milk fill full the waters which avail in solenm rites. They lead, as 'twere, the Strong Horse forth, that it may rain: they milk the thundering, the neverfailing spring.

sanskrit: mahiṣāsaḥ māyinaḥ citra bhānavaḥ girayaḥ na sva tavasaḥ raghu syadaḥ mr̥gāḥ iva hastinaḥ svādatha vanā yat āruṇīṣu taviṣīḥ ayugdhvam
english: Mighty, with wondrous power and marvellously bright, selfstrong like mountains, ye glide swiftly on your way. Like the wild elephants ye eat the forests up when ye assume your strength among the bright red flames.

sanskrit: siṁhāḥ iva nānadati pra cetasaḥ piśāḥ iva su piśaḥ viśva vedasaḥ kṣapaḥ jinvantaḥ pr̥ṣatībhiḥ r̥ṣṭi bhiḥ sam it sa bādhaḥ śavasā ahi manyavaḥ
english: Exceeding wise they roar like lions mightily, they, all-possessing, are beauteous as antelopes; Stirring the darkness with lances and spotted deer, combined as priests, with serpents' fury through their might.

sanskrit: rodasī iti ā vadata gaṇa śriyaḥ nr̥ sācaḥ śūrāḥ śavasā ahi manyavaḥ ā vandhureṣu amatiḥ na darśatā vidyut na tasthau marutaḥ ratheṣu vaḥ
english: Heroes who march in companies, befriending man, with serpents' ire through strength, ye greet the earth and heaven. Upon the seats, O Maruts, of your chariots, upon the cars stands lightning visible as light.
