sanskrit: viśva vedasaḥ rayi bhiḥ sam okasaḥ sam miślāsaḥ taviṣībhiḥ vi rapśinaḥ astāraḥ iṣum dadhire gabhastyoḥ ananta śuṣmāḥ vr̥ṣa khādayaḥ naraḥ
english: Lords of all riches, dwelling in the home of wealth, endowed with mighty vigour, singers loud of voice, Heroes, of powers infinite, armed with strong men's rings, the archers, they have laid the arrow on their arms.

sanskrit: hiraṇyayebhiḥ pavi bhiḥ payaḥ vr̥dhaḥ ut jighnante āpathyaḥ na parvatān makhāḥ ayāsaḥ sva sr̥taḥ dhruva cyutaḥ dudhra kr̥taḥ marutaḥ bhrājat r̥ṣṭayaḥ
english: They who with golden fellies make the rain increase drive forward the big clouds like wanderers on the way. Self-moving, brisk, unwearied, they o'erthrow the firm; the Maruts with bright lances make all things to reel.

sanskrit: ghr̥ṣum pāvakam vaninam vi carṣaṇim rudrasya sūnum havasā gr̥ṇīmas i rajaḥ turam tavasam mārutam gaṇam r̥jīṣiṇam vr̥ṣaṇam saścata śriye
english: The progeny of Rudra we invoke with prayer, the brisk, the bright, the worshipful, the active Ones To the strong band of Maruts cleave for happiness, the chasers of the sky, impetuous, vigorous.

sanskrit: pra nu saḥ martaḥ śavasā janān ati tasthau vaḥ ūtī marutaḥ yam āvata arvat bhiḥ vājam bharate dhanā nr̥ bhiḥ āpr̥cchyam kratum ā kṣeti puṣyati
english: Maruts, the man whom ye have guarded with your help, he verily in strength surpasseth all mankind. Spoil with his steeds he gaineth, treasure with his men; he winneth honourable strength and prospereth.

sanskrit: carkr̥tyam marutaḥ pr̥t su dustaram dyu mantam śuṣmam maghavat su dhattana dhana spr̥tam ukthyam viśva carṣaṇim tokam puṣyema tanayam śatam himāḥ
english: O Maruts, to the worshippers give glorious strength invincible in battle, brilliant, bringing wealth, Praiseworthy, known to all men. May we foster well, during a hundred winters, son and progeny.

sanskrit: nu sthiram marutaḥ vīra vantam r̥ti saham rayim asmāsu dhatta sahasriṇam śatinam śūśu vāṁsam prātaḥ makṣu dhiyāvasuḥ jagamyāt
english: Will ye then, O ye Maruts, grant us riches, durable, rich in men, defying onslaught. A hundred, thousandfold, ever increasing? May he, enriched with prayer, come soon and early.

sanskrit: paśvā na tāyum guhā catantam namaḥ yujānam namaḥ vahantam
english: ONE-MINDED, wise, they tracked thee like a thief lurking in dark cave with a stolen cow; Thee claiming worship, bearing it to Gods : there nigh to thee sate all the Holy Ones.

sanskrit: sajoṣāḥ dhīrāḥ padaiḥ anu gman upa tvā sīdan viśve yajatrāḥ
english: ONE-MINDED, wise, they tracked thee like a thief lurking in dark cave with a stolen cow; Thee claiming worship, bearing it to Gods : there nigh to thee sate all the Holy Ones.

sanskrit: r̥tasya devāḥ anu vratā guḥ bhuvat pariṣṭiḥ dyauḥ na bhūma
english: The Gods approached the ways of holy Law; there was a gathering vast as heaven itself.

sanskrit: vardhanti īm āpaḥ panvā su śiśvim r̥tasya yonā garbhe su jātam
english: The waters feed with praise the growing Babe, born nobly in the womb, the seat of Law.

sanskrit: puṣṭiḥ na raṇvā kṣitiḥ na pr̥thvī giriḥ na bhujma kṣodaḥ na śam bhu
english: Like grateful food, like some wide dwelling place, like a fruit-bearing hill, a wholesome stream.

sanskrit: atyaḥ na ajman sarga prataktaḥ sindhuḥ na kṣodaḥ kaḥ im varāte
english: Like a steed urged to run in swift career, rushing like Sindhu, who may check his course?

sanskrit: jāmiḥ sindhūnām bhrātāiva svasrām ibhyān na rājā vanāni atti
english: Kin as a brother to his sister floods, he eats the woods as a King eats the rich.

sanskrit: yat vāta jūtaḥ vanā vi asthāt agniḥ ha dāti roma pr̥thivyāḥ
english: When through the forest, urged by wind, he spreads, verily Agni shears the hair of earth.

sanskrit: śvasiti ap su haṁsaḥ na sīdan kratvā cetiṣṭhaḥ viśām uṣaḥ bhut
english: Like a swan sitting in the floods he pants wisest in mind mid men he wakes at morn.

sanskrit: somaḥ na vedhāḥ r̥ta prajātaḥ paśuḥ na śiśvā vi bhuḥ dūre bhāḥ
english: A Sage like Soma, sprung from Law, he grew like some young creature, mighty, shining far.

sanskrit: rayiḥ na citrā sūraḥ na sam dr̥k āyuḥ na prāṇaḥ nityaḥ na sūnuḥ
english: LIKE the Sun's glance, like wealth of varied sort, like breath which is the life, like one's own son,

sanskrit: takvā na bhūrṇiḥ vanā saisakti payaḥ na dhenuḥ śuciḥ vibhāvā
english: Like a swift bird, a cow who yields her milk, pure and refulgent to the wood he speeds.

sanskrit: dādhāra kṣemam okaḥ na raṇvaḥ yavaḥ na pakvaḥ jetā janānām
english: He offers safety like a pleasant home, like ripened corn, the Conqueror of men.

sanskrit: r̥ṣiḥ na stubhvā vikṣu pra śastaḥ vājī na prītaḥ vayaḥ dadhāti
english: Like a Seer lauding, famed among the folk; like a steed friendly he vouchsafes us power.

sanskrit: duroka śociḥ kratuḥ na nityaḥ jāyāiva yonau aram viśvasmai
english: With flame insatiate, like eternal might; caring for each one like a dame at home;

sanskrit: citraḥ yat abhrāṭ śvetaḥ na vikṣu rathaḥ na rukmī tveṣaḥ samat su
english: Bright when he shines forth, whitish mid the folk, like a car, gold-decked, thundering to the fight.

sanskrit: senāiva sr̥ṣṭā amam dadhāti astuḥ na didyut tveṣa pratīkā
english: He strikes with terror like a dart shot forth, e'en like an archer's arrow tipped with flame;

sanskrit: yamaḥ ha jātaḥ yamaḥ jani tvam jāraḥ kanīnām patiḥ janīnām
english: Master of present and of future life, the maidens' lover and the matrons' Lord.

sanskrit: tam vaḥ carāthā vayam vasatyā astam na gāvaḥ nakṣante iddham
english: To him lead all your ways: may we attain the kindled God as cows their home at eve.

sanskrit: sindhuḥ na kṣodaḥ pra nīcīḥ ainot navante gāvaḥ svaḥ dr̥śīke
english: He drives the flames below as floods their swell: the rays rise up to the fair place of heaven.

sanskrit: vaneṣu jāyuḥ marteṣu mitraḥ vr̥ṇīte śruṣtim rājāiva ajuryam
english: VICTORIOUS in the wood, Friend among men, ever he claims obedience as a King.

sanskrit: kṣemaḥ na sādhuḥ kratuḥ na bhadraḥ bhuvat su ādhīḥ hotā havya vāṭ
english: Gracious like peace, blessing like mental power, Priest was he, offering-bearer, full of thought.

sanskrit: haste dadhānaḥ nr̥mṇā viśvāni ame devān dhāt guhā ni sīdan
english: He, bearing in his hand all manly might, crouched in the cavern, struck the Gods with fear.

sanskrit: vidanti īm atra naraḥ dhiyam dhāḥ hr̥dā yat taṣṭān mantrān aśaṁsan
english: Men filled with understanding find him there, when they have sting prayers formed within their heart.

sanskrit: ajaḥ na kṣām dādhāra pr̥thivīm tastambha dyām mantrebhiḥ satyaiḥ
english: He, like the Unborn, holds the broad earth up; and with effective utterance fixed the sky.

sanskrit: priyā padāni paśvaḥ ni pāhi viśva āyuḥ agne guhā guham gāḥ
english: O Agni, guard the spots which cattle love: thou, life of all, hast gone from lair to lair.

sanskrit: yaḥ īm ciketa guhā bhavantam ā yaḥ sasāda dhārām r̥tasya
english: Whoso hath known him dwelling in his lair, and hath approached the stream of holy Law,–

sanskrit: vi ye cr̥tanti r̥tā sapantaḥ āt it vasūni pra vavāca asmai
english: They who release him, paying sacred rites, -truly to such doth he announce great wealth.

sanskrit: vi yaḥ vīrut su rodhat mahi tvā uta pra jāḥ uta pra sūṣu antarit i
english: He who grows mightily in herbs, within each fruitful mother and each babe she bears,

sanskrit: cittiḥ apām dame viśva āyuḥ sadma iva dhīrāḥ sam māya cakruḥ
english: Wise, life of all men, in the waters' home,– for him have sages built as 'twere a seat.

sanskrit: śrīṇan upa sthāt divam bhuraṇyuḥ sthātuḥ caratham aktūn vi ūrṇot
english: COMMINGLING, restless, he ascends the sky, unveiling nights and all that stands or moves,

sanskrit: pari yat eṣām ekaḥ viśveṣām bhuvat devaḥ devānām mahi tvā
english: As he the sole God is preeminent in greatness among all these other Gods.

sanskrit: āt it te viśve kratum juṣanta śuṣkāt yat deva jīvaḥ janiṣṭhāḥ
english: All men are joyful in thy power, O God, that living from the dry wood thou art born.

sanskrit: bhajanta viśve deva tvam nāma r̥tam sapantaḥ amr̥tam evaiḥ
english: All truly share thy Godhead while they keep, in their accustomed ways, eternal Law.

sanskrit: r̥tasya preṣāḥ r̥tasya dhītiḥ viśva āyuḥ viśve apāṁsi cakruḥ
english: Strong is the thought of Law, the Law's behest; all works have they performed; he quickens all.

sanskrit: yaḥ tubhyam dāśāt yaḥ vā te śikṣāt tasmai cikitvān rayim dayasva
english: Whoso will bring oblation, gifts to thee, to him, bethinking thee, vouchsafe thou wealth.

sanskrit: hotā ni sattaḥ manoḥ apatye saḥ cit nu āsām patiḥ rayīṇām
english: Seated as Priest with Manu's progeny, of all these treasures he alone is Lord.

sanskrit: icchanta retaḥ mithaḥ tanūṣu sam jānata svaiḥ dakṣaiḥ amūrāḥ
english: Men yearn for children to prolong their line, and are not disappointed in their hope.

sanskrit: pituḥ na putrāḥ kratum juṣanta śroṣan ye asya śāsam turāsaḥ
english: Eagerly they who hear his word fulfil his wish as sons obey their sire's behest.

sanskrit: vi rāyaḥ aurṇot duraḥ puru kṣuḥ pipeśa nākam str̥ bhiḥ damūnāḥ
english: He, rich in food, unbars his wealth like doors: he, the House-Friend, bath decked heaven's vault with stars.

sanskrit: śukraḥ śuśukvān uṣaḥ na jāraḥ paprā samīcī itisam īcī divaḥ na jyotiḥ
english: BRIGHT, splendid, like Dawn's lover, he bath filled the two joined worlds as with the light of heaven.

sanskrit: pari pra jātaḥ kratvā babhūtha bhuvaḥ devānām pitā putraḥ san
english: When born, with might thou hast encompassed them: Father of Gods, and yet their Son wast thou.

sanskrit: vedhāḥ adr̥ptaḥ agniḥ vi janan ūdhaḥ na gonām svādma pitūnām
english: Agni, the Sage, the humble, who discerns like the cow's udder, the sweet taste of food,

sanskrit: jane na śeva āhūryaḥ san madhye ni sattaḥ raṇvaḥ duroṇe
english: Like a bliss-giver to be drawn to men, sits gracious in the middle of the house.

sanskrit: putraḥ na jātaḥ raṇvaḥ duroṇe vājī na prītaḥ viśaḥ vi tārīt
english: Born in the dwelling like a lovely son, pleased, like a strong steed, he bears on the folk.

sanskrit: viśaḥ yat ahve nr̥ bhiḥ sa nīl̥āḥ agniḥ deva tvā viśvāni aśyāḥ
english: What time the men and I, with heroes, call, may Agni then gain all through Godlike power.

sanskrit: nakiḥ te etā vratā minanti nr̥ bhyaḥ yat ebhyaḥ śruṣṭim cakartha
english: None breaks these holy laws of thine when thou hast granted audience to these chieftains here.

sanskrit: tat tu te daṁsaḥ yat ahan samānaiḥ nr̥ bhiḥ yat yuktaḥ viveḥ rapāṁsi
english: This is thy boast, thou smotest with thy peers, and joined with heroes dravest off disgrace.

sanskrit: uṣaḥ na jāraḥ vibhāvā usraḥ sañjñāta rūpaḥ ciketat asmai
english: Like the Dawn's lover, spreading light, well-known as hued like morn, may he remember me.

sanskrit: tmanā vahantaḥ duraḥ vi r̥ṇvan navanta viśve svaḥ dr̥śīke
english: They, bearing of themselves, unbar the doors: they all ascend to the fair place of heaven.

sanskrit: vanema pūrvīḥ aryaḥ manīṣā agniḥ suśokaḥ viśvāni aśyāḥ
english: MAY we, the pious, win much food by prayer, may Agni with fair light pervade each act,–

sanskrit: ā daivyāni vratā cikitvān ā mānuṣasya janasya janma
english: He the observer of the heavenly laws of Gods, and of the race of mortal man.

sanskrit: garbhaḥ yaḥ apām garbhaḥ vanānām garbhaḥ ca sthātām garbhaḥ carathām
english: He who is germ of waters, germ of woods, germ of all things that move not and that move,–

sanskrit: adrau cit asmai antaḥ duroṇe viśām na viśvaḥ amr̥taḥ su ādhīḥ
english: To him even in the rock and in the house: Immortal One, he cares for all mankind.

sanskrit: saḥ hi kṣapāvān agniḥ rayīṇām dāśat yaḥ asmai aram su uktaiḥ
english: Agni is Lord of riches for the man who serves him readily with sacred songs.

sanskrit: etā cikitvaḥ bhūma ni pāhi devānām janma martān ca vidvān
english: Protect these beings thou with careful thought, knowing the races both of Gods and men.

sanskrit: vardhān yam pūrvīḥ kṣapaḥ vi rūpāḥ sthātuḥ ca ratham r̥ta pravītam
english: Whom many dawns and nights, unlike, make strong, whom, born in Law, all things that move and stand,–

sanskrit: arādhi hotā svaḥ ni sattaḥ kr̥ṇvan viśvāni apāṁsi satyā
english: He bath been won, Herald who sits in light, making effectual all our holy works.

sanskrit: goṣu pra śastim vaneṣu dhiṣe bharanta viśve balim svaḥ naḥ
english: Thou settest value on our cows and woods: all shall bring tribute to us, to the light.

sanskrit: vi tvā naraḥ puru trā saparyan pituḥ na jivreḥ vi vedī bharanta
english: Men have served thee in many and sundry spots, parting, as 'twere, an aged father's wealth.

sanskrit: sādhuḥ na gr̥dhnuḥ astāiva śūraḥ yātāiva bhīmaḥ tveṣaḥ samat su
english: Like a brave archer, like one skilled and bold, a fierce avenger, so he shines in fight.

sanskrit: upa pra jinvan uśatīḥ uśantam patim na nityam janayaḥ sa nīl̥āḥ svasāraḥ śyāvīm aruṣīm ajuṣran citram ucchantīm uṣasam na gāvaḥ
english: LOVING the loving One, as wives their husband, the sisters of one home have urged him forward, Bright-coloured, even, as the cows love morning, dark, breaking forth to view, and redly beaming.

sanskrit: vīl̥u cit dr̥l̥hā pitaraḥ naḥ ukthaiḥ adrim rujan aṅgirasaḥ raveṇa cakruḥ divaḥ br̥hataḥ gātum asme iti ahariti svaḥ vividuḥ ketum usrāḥ
english: Our sires with lauds burst e'en the firmset fortress, yea, the Angirases, with roar, the mountain. They made for us a way to reach high heaven, they found us day, light, day's sign, beams of morning.

sanskrit: dadhan r̥tam dhanayan asya dhītim āt it aryaḥ dadhiṣvaḥ vi bhr̥trāḥ atr̥ṣyantīḥ apasaḥ yanti accha devān janma prayasā vardhayantīḥ
english: They stablished order, made his service fruitful; then parting them among the longing faithful, Not thirsting after aught, they come, most active, while with sweet food the race of Gods they strengthen.

sanskrit: mathīt yat īm vi bhr̥taḥ mātariśvā gr̥he gr̥he śyetaḥ jenyaḥ bhūt ādīm rājñe na sahīyase sacā san ā dūtyam bhr̥gavāṇaḥ vivāya
english: Since Mâtariṣvan, far-diffused, bath stirred him, and he in every house grown bright and noble, He, Bhr̥igu-like I hath gone as his companion, as on commission to a greater Sovran.

sanskrit: mahe yat pitre īm rasam dive kaḥ ava tsarat pr̥śanyaḥ cikitvān sr̥jat astā dhr̥ṣatā didyum asmai svāyām devaḥ duhitari tviṣim dhāt
english: When man poured juice to Heaven, the mighty Father, he knew and freed himself from close embracement. The archer boldly shot at him his arrow, and the God threw his splendour on his Daughter.

sanskrit: sve ā yaḥ tubhyam dame ā vi bhāti namaḥ vā dāśāt uśataḥ anu dyūn vardhaḥ agne vayaḥ asya dvi barhāḥ yāsat rāyā sa ratham yam junāsi
english: Whoso, bath flames for thee within his dwelling, or brings the worship which thou lovest daily, Do thou of double might increase his substance: may he whom thou incitest meet with riches.

sanskrit: agnim viśvāḥ abhi pr̥kṣaḥ sacante samudram na sravataḥ sapta yahvīḥ na jāmibhiḥ vi cikite vayaḥ naḥ vidāḥ deveṣu pra matim cikitvān
english: All sacrificial viands wait on Agni as the Seven mighty Rivers seek the ocean. Not by our brethren was our food discovered: find with the Gods care for us, thou who knowest.

sanskrit: ā yat iṣe nr̥ patim tejaḥ ānaṭ śuci retaḥ ni siktam dyauḥ abhīke agniḥ śardham anavadyam yuvānam su ādhyam janayat sūdayat ca
english: When light bath filled the Lord of men for increase, straight from the heaven descends the limpid moisture. Agni bath brought to light and filled with spirit the youthful host blameless and well providing.

sanskrit: manaḥ na yaḥ adhvanaḥ sadyaḥ eti ekaḥ satrā sūraḥ vasvaḥ īśe rājānā mitrāvaruṇā supāṇī itisu pāṇī goṣu priyam amr̥tam rakṣamāṇā
english: He who like thought goes swiftly on his journey, the Sun, alone is ever Lord of riches. The Kings with fair hands, Varuṇa and Mitra, protect the precious nectar in our cattle.

sanskrit: mā naḥ agne sakhyā pitryāṇi pra marṣiṣṭhāḥ abhi viduḥ kaviḥ san nabhaḥ na rūpam jarimā mināti purā tasyāḥ abhi śasteḥ adhi ihi
english: O Agni, break not our ancestral friendship, Sage as thou art, endowed with deepest knowledge. Old age, like gathering cloud, impairs the body: before that evil be come nigh protect me.

sanskrit: ni kāvyā vedhasaḥ śaśvataḥ kaḥ haste dadhānaḥ naryā purūṇi agniḥ bhuvat rayi patiḥ rayīṇām satrā cakrāṇaḥ amr̥tāni viśvā
english: THOUGH holding many gifts for men, he humbleth the higher powers of each wise ordainer. Agni is now the treasure-lord of treasures, for ever granting all immortal bounties.

sanskrit: asme iti vatsam pari santam na vindan icchantaḥ viśve amr̥tāḥ amūrāḥ śrama yuvaḥ padavyaḥ dhiyam dhāḥ tasthuḥ pade parame cāru agneḥ
english: The Gods infallible all searching found not him, the dear Babe who still is round about us. Worn weary, following his track, devoted, they reached the lovely highest home of Agni.

sanskrit: tisraḥ yat agne śaradaḥ tvām it śucim ghr̥tena śucayaḥ saparyān nāmāni cit dadhire yajñiyāni asūdayanta tanvaḥ su jātāḥ
english: Because with holy oil the pure Ones, Agni, served thee the very pure three autumn seasons, Therefore they won them holy names for worship, and nobly born they dignified their bodies.

sanskrit: ā rodasī iti br̥hatī iti vevidānāḥ pra rudriyā jabhrire yajñiyāsaḥ vidat martaḥ nema dhitā cikitvān agnim pade parame tasthi vāṁsam
english: Making them known to spacious earth and heaven, the holy Ones revealed the powers of Rudra. The mortal band, discerning in the distance, found Agni standing in the loftiest station.

sanskrit: sam jānānāḥ upa sīdan abhi jñu patnī vantaḥ namasyam namasyannitinamasyan ririkvāṁsaḥ tanvaḥ kr̥ṇvata svāḥ sakhā sakhyuḥ n i miṣi rakṣamāṇāḥ
english: Nigh they approached, one-minded, with their spouses, kneeling to him adorable paid worship. Friend finding in his own friend's eye protection, they made their own the bodies which they chastened.

sanskrit: triḥ sapta yat guhyāni tveiti it padā avidan ni hitāḥ yajñiyāsaḥ tebhiḥ rakṣante amr̥tam sa joṣāḥ paśūn ca sthātr̥r̥n caratham ca pāhi
english: Soon as the holy beings had discovered the thrice-seven mystic things contained within thee, With these, one-minded., they preserve the Amrit: guard thou the life of all their plants and cattle.

sanskrit: vidvān agne vayunāni kṣitīnām vi ānuṣak śurudhaḥ jīvase dhāḥ antaḥ vidvān adhvanaḥ deva yānān atandraḥ dūtaḥ abhavaḥ haviḥ vāṭ
english: Thou, Agni, knower of men's works, hast sent us good food in constant course for our subsistence: Thou deeply skilled in paths of Gods becamest an envoy never wearied, offeringbearer.

sanskrit: svu ādhyaḥ divaḥ ā sapta yahvīḥ rāyaḥ duraḥ vi r̥ta jñāḥ ajānan vidat gavyam saramā dr̥l̥ham ūrvam yena nu kam mānuṣī bhojate viṭ
english: Knowing the Law, the seven strong floods from heaven, full of good thought, discerned the doors of riches. Saramâ found the cattle's firm-built prison whereby the race of man is still supported.

sanskrit: ā ye viśvā su apatyāni tasthuḥ kr̥ṇvānāsaḥ amr̥ta tvāya gātum mahnā mahat bhiḥ pr̥thivī vi tasthe mātā putraiḥ aditiḥ dhāyase veḥ
english: They who approached all noble operations making a path that leads to life immortal, To be the Bird's support, the spacious mother, Aditi, and her great Sons stood in power.

sanskrit: adhi śriyam ni dadhuḥ cārum asmin divaḥ yat akṣī iti amr̥tāḥ akr̥ṇvan adha kṣaranti sindhavaḥ na sr̥ṣṭāḥ pra nīcīḥ agne aruṣīḥ ajānan
english: When Gods immortal made both eyes of heaven, they gave to him the gift of beauteous glory. Now they flow forth like rivers set in motion: they knew the Red Steeds coming down, O Agni.

sanskrit: rayiḥ na yaḥ pitr̥ vittaḥ vayaḥ dhāḥ su pranītiḥ cikituṣaḥ na śāsuḥ syona śīḥ atithiḥ na prīṇānaḥ hotāiva sadma vidhataḥ vi tārīt
english: HE who gives food, like patrimonial riches and guides aright like some wise man's instruction, Loved like a guest who lies in pleasant lodging, – may he, as Priest, prosper his servant's dwelling.

sanskrit: devaḥ na yaḥ savitā satya manmā kratvā ni pāti vr̥janāni viśvā puru praśastaḥ amatiḥ na satyaḥ ātmāiva śevaḥ didhiṣāyyaḥ bhūt
english: He who like Savitar the God, true-minded protecteth with his power. all acts of vigour, Truthful, like splendourr, glorified by many, like breath joy-giving,– all must strive to win him.

sanskrit: devaḥ na yaḥ pr̥thivīm viśva dhāyāḥ upa kṣeti hita mitraḥ na rājā puraḥ sadaḥ śarma sadaḥ na vīrāḥ anavadyā patijuṣṭāiva nārī
english: He who on earth dwells like a king surrounded by faithful friends, like a God all-sustaining, Like heroes who preside, who sit in safety: like as a blameless dame dear to her husband.

sanskrit: tam tvā naraḥ dame ā nityam iddham agne sacanta kṣitiṣu dhruvāsu adhi dyumnam ni dadhuḥ bhūri asmin bhava viśva āyuḥ dharuṇaḥ rayīṇām
english: Thee, such, in settlements secure, O Agni, our men serve ever kindled in each dwelling. On him have they laid splendour in abundance: dear to all men, bearer be he of riches.

sanskrit: vi pr̥kṣaḥ agne magha vānaḥ aśyuḥ vi sūrayaḥ dadataḥ viśvam āyuḥ sanema vājam sam itheṣu aryaḥ bhāgam deveṣu śravase dadhānāḥ
english: May thy rich worshippers win food, O Agni, and princes gain long life who bring oblation. May we get booty from jur foe in battle, presenting to the Gods their share for glory.

sanskrit: r̥tasya hi dhenavaḥ vāvaśānāḥ smat ūdhnīḥ pīpayanta dyu bhaktāḥ parāvataḥ su matim bhikṣamāṇāḥ vi sindhavaḥ samayā sasruḥ adrim
english: The cows of holy law, sent us by Heaven, have swelled with laden udders, loudly lowing; Soliciting his favour, from a distance the rivers to the rock have flowed together.

sanskrit: tve agne su matim bhikṣamāṇāḥ divi śravaḥ dadhire yajñiyāḥ naktā ca cakruḥ uṣasā virūpeitivi rūpe kr̥ṣṇam ca varṇam aruṇam ca sam dhurit idhuḥ
english: Agni, with thee, soliciting thy favour, the holy Ones have gained glory in heaven. They made the Night and Dawn of different colours, and set the black and purple hues together.

sanskrit: yān rāye martān susūdaḥ agne te syāma magha vānaḥ vayam ca chāyāiva viśvam bhuvanam sisakṣi āpapri vān rodasī iti antarikṣam
english: May we and those who worship be the mortals whom thou, O Agni, leadest on to riches. Thou hast filled earth and heaven and air's mid-region, and followest the whole world like a shadow.

sanskrit: arvat bhiḥ agne arvataḥ nr̥bhiḥ nr̥r̥n vīrair vīrān vanuyāmā tvotāḥ īśānāsaḥ pitr̥ vittasyar yaḥ vi sūrayaḥ śata himāḥ naḥ aśyuḥ
english: Aided by thee, O Agni, may we conquer steeds with steeds, men with men, heroes with heroes, Lords of the wealth transmitted by our fathers: and may our princes live a hundred winters.

sanskrit: etā te agne ucathāni vedhaḥ juṣṭāni santu manase hr̥de ca śakema rāyaḥ su dhuraḥ yamam te adhi śravaḥ deva bhaktam dadhānāḥ
english: May these our hymns of praise, Agni, Ordainer, be pleasant to thee in thy heart and spirit. May we have power to hold thy steeds of riches, laying on thee the God-sent gift of glory.

sanskrit: upa prayantaḥ adhvaram mantram vocema agnaye āre asme iti ca śr̥ṇvate
english: As forth to sacrifice we go, a hymn to a hymn let us say, Who hears us even when afar;

sanskrit: yaḥ snīhitīṣu pūrvyaḥ sam jagmānāsu kr̥ṣṭiṣu arakṣat dāśuṣe gayam
english: Who, from of old, in carnage, when the people gathered, hath preserved His household for the worshipper.

sanskrit: uta bruvantu jantavaḥ ut agniḥ vr̥tra hā ajani dhanam jayaḥ raṇe raṇe
english: And let men say, Agni is born, e'en he who slayeth Vr̥itra, he Who winneth wealth in every fight.

sanskrit: yasya dūtaḥ asi kṣaye veṣi havyāni vītaye dasmat kr̥ṇoṣi adhvaram
english: Him in whose house an envoy thou lovest to taste his offered gifts, And strengthenest his sacrifice,

sanskrit: tam it su havyam aṅgiraḥ su devam sahasaḥ yaho iti janāḥ āhuḥ su barhiṣam
english: Him, Angiras, thou Son of Strength, all men call happy in his God, His offerings, and his sacred grass.

sanskrit: ā ca vahāsi tān iha devān upa pra śastaye havyā su candra vītaye
english: Hitherward shalt thou bring these Gods to our laudation and to taste. These offered gifts, fair-shining One.

sanskrit: na yoḥ upabdiḥ aśvyaḥ śr̥ṇve rathasya kat cana yat agne yāsi dūtyam
english: When, Agni, on thine embassage thou goest not a sound is heard of steed or straining of thy car.

sanskrit: tvāūtaḥ vājī ahrayaḥ abhi pūrvasmāt aparaḥ pra dāśvān agne asthāt
english: Aided by thee uninjured, strong, one after other, goes he forth: Agni, the ofterer forward steps.

sanskrit: uta dyu mat su vīryam br̥hat agne vivāsasi devebhyaḥ deva dāśuṣe
english: And splendid strength, heroic, high, Agni, thou grantest from the Gods, Thou God, to him who offers gifts.

sanskrit: juṣasva saprathaḥ tamam vacaḥ devapsaraḥ tamam havyā juhvānaḥ āsani
english: ACCEPT our loudest-sounding hymn, food most delightful to the Gods, Pouring our offerings in thy mouth.

sanskrit: atha te aṅgiraḥ tama agne vedhaḥ tama priyam vocema brahma sānasi
english: Now, Agni, will we say to thee, O wisest and best Afigiras, Our precious, much-availing prayer.

sanskrit: kaḥ te jāmiḥ janānām agne kaḥ dāśu adhvaraḥ kaḥ ha kasmin asi śritaḥ
english: Who, Agni, is thy kin, of men? who is thy worthy worshipper? On whom dependent? who art thou?

sanskrit: tvam jāmiḥ janānām agne mitraḥ asi priyaḥ sakhā sakhi bhyaḥ īḍyaḥ
english: The kinsman, Agni, of mankind, their well beloved Friend art thou, A Friend whom friends may supplicate.

sanskrit: yaja naḥ mitrāvaruṇā yaja devān r̥tam br̥hat agne yakṣi svam damam
english: Bring to us Mitra, Varuṇa, bring the Gods to mighty sacrifice. Bring them, O Agni, to thine home.

sanskrit: kā te upa itiḥ manasaḥ varāya bhuvat agne śam tamā kā manīṣā kaḥ vā yajñaiḥ pari dakṣam te āpa kena vā te manasā dāśema
english: How may the mind draw nigh to please thee, Agni? What hymn of praise shall bring us greatest blessing? Or who hath gained thy power by sacrifices? or with what mind shall we bring thee oblations?

sanskrit: ā ihi agne iha hotā ni sīda adabdhaḥ su puraḥ etā bhava naḥ avatām tvā rodasī iti viśvaminve itiviśvam inve yaja mahe saumanasāya devān
english: Come hither, Agni; sit thee down as Hotar; be thou who never wast deceived our leader. May Heaven and Earth, the all-pervading, love thee: worship the Gods to win for us their favour.

sanskrit: pra su viśvān rakṣasaḥ dhakṣi agne bhava yajñānām abhiśasti pāvā atha ā vaha soma patim hari bhyām ātithyam asmai cakr̥ma su dāvne
english: Burn thou up all the Riksasas, O Agni; ward thou off curses from our sacrifices. Bring hither with his Bays the Lord of Soma: here is glad welcome for the Bounteous Giver.

sanskrit: prajāvatā vacasā vahniḥ āsā ā ca huve ni ca satsi iha devaiḥ veṣi hotram uta potram yajatra bodhi pra yantaḥ janitaḥ vasūnām
english: Thou Priest with lip and voice that bring us children hast been invoked. Here with the Gods be seated. Thine is the task of Cleanser and Presenter: waken us, Wealth-bestower and Producer.

sanskrit: yathā viprasya manuṣaḥ haviḥ bhiḥ devān ayajaḥ kavi bhiḥ kaviḥ san eva hotariti satya tara tvam adya agne mandrayā juhvā yajasva
english: As with oblations of the priestly Manus thou worshippedst the Gods, a Sage with sages, So now, O truthfullest Invoker Agni, worship this day with joy-bestowing ladle.

sanskrit: kathā dāśema agnaye kā asmai deva juṣṭā ucyate bhāmine gīḥ yaḥ martyeṣu amr̥taḥ r̥ta vā hotā yajiṣṭhaḥ it kr̥ṇoti devān
english: How shall we pay oblation unto Agni? What hymn, Godloved, is said to him refulgent? Who, deathless, true to Law, mid men a herald, bringeth the Gods as best of sacrificers?

sanskrit: yaḥ adhvareṣu śam tamaḥ r̥ta vā hotā tam oṁ iti namaḥ bhiḥ ā kr̥ṇudhvam agniḥ yat veḥ martāya devān saḥ ca bodhāti manasā yajāti
english: Bring him with reverence hither, most propitious in sacrifices, true to Law, the herald; For Agni, when he seeks the Gods for mortals, knows them full well and worships them in spirit.

sanskrit: saḥ hi kratuḥ saḥ maryaḥ saḥ sādhuḥ mitraḥ na bhūt adbhutasya rathīḥ tam medheṣu prathamam deva yantīḥ viśaḥ upa bruvate dasmam ārīḥ
english: For he is mental power, a man, and perfect; he is the bringer, friend-,like, of the wondrous. The pious Aryan tribes at sacrifices address them first to him who doeth marvels.

sanskrit: saḥ naḥ nr̥ṇām nr̥ tamaḥ riśādāḥ agniḥ giraḥ avasā vetu dhītim tanā ca ye magha vānaḥ śaviṣṭhāḥ vāja prasūtāḥ iṣayanta manma
english: May Agni, foe-destroyer, manliest Hero, accept with love our hymns and our devotion. So may the liberal lords whose strength is strongest, urged by their riches, stir our thoughts with vigour.

sanskrit: eva agniḥ gotamebhiḥ r̥ta vā viprebhiḥ astoṣṭa jāta vedāḥ saḥ eṣu dyumnam pīpayat saḥ vājam saḥ puṣṭim yāti joṣam ā cikitvān
english: Thus Agni Jâtavedas, true to Order, hath by the priestly Gotamas been lauded. May he augment in them splendour and vigour: observant, as he lists, he gathers increase.

sanskrit: abhi tvā gotamāḥ girā jāta vedaḥ vi carṣaṇe dyumnaiḥ abhi pra nonumaḥ
english: O JâtavEDAS, keen and swift, we Gotamas with sacred song exalt thee for thy glories' sake.

sanskrit: tam oṁ iti tvā gotamaḥ girā rāyaḥ kāmaḥ duvasyati dyumnaiḥ abhi pra nonumaḥ
english: Thee, as thou art, desiring wealth Gotama worships with his song: We laud thee for thy glories' sake.

sanskrit: tam oṁ iti tvā vāja sātamam aṅgirasvat havāmahe dyumnaiḥ abhi pra nonumaḥ
english: As such, like Angiras we call on thee best winner of the spoil: We laud thee for thy glories' sake.

sanskrit: tam oṁ iti tvā vr̥trahan tamam yaḥ dasyūn ava dhūnuṣe dyumnaiḥ abhi pra nonumaḥ
english: Thee, best of Vr̥itra-slayers, thee who shakest off our Dasyu foes: We laud thee for thy glories' sake.

sanskrit: avocāma rahūgaṇāḥ agnaye madhu mat vacaḥ dyumnaiḥ abhi pra nonumaḥ
english: A pleasant song to Agni we, sons of Rahûgaṇa, have sung: We laud thee for thy glories' sake.

sanskrit: hiraṇya keśaḥ rajasaḥ vi sāre ahiḥ dhuniḥ vātaḥ iva dhrajīmān śuci bhrājāḥ uṣasaḥ navedāḥ yaśasvatīḥ apasyuvaḥ na satyāḥ
english: HE in mid-air's expanse hath golden tresses; a raging serpent, like the rushing tempest: Purely refulgent, knowing well the morn. ing; like honourable dames, true, active workers.

sanskrit: ā te su parṇāḥ aminanta evaiḥ kr̥ṣṇaḥ nonāva vr̥ṣabhaḥ yadi idam śivābhiḥ na smayamānābhiḥ ā agāt patanti mihaḥ stanayanti abhr̥ā
english: Thy well-winged flashes strengthen in their manner, when the black Bull hath bellowed round about us. With drops that bless and seem to smile he cometh: the waters fall, the clouds utter their thunder.

sanskrit: yat īm r̥tasya payasā piyānaḥ nayan r̥tasya pathi bhiḥ rajiṣṭhaiḥ ayarmā mitraḥ varuṇaḥ pari jmā tvacam pr̥ñcanti uparasya yonau
english: When he comes streaming with the milk of worship, conducting by directest paths of Order Aryaman, Mitra, Varuṇa, Parijman fill the hide full where lies the nether press-stone.

sanskrit: agne vājasya gomataḥ īśānaḥ sahasaḥ yaho iti asme iti dhehi jāta vedaḥ mahi śravaḥ
english: O Agni, thou who art the lord of wealth in kine, thou Son of Strength, Vouchsafe to us, O Jâtavetlas, high renown.

sanskrit: saḥ idhānaḥ vasuḥ kaviḥ agniḥ īl̥enyaḥ girā revat asmabhyam puru aṇīka dīdihi
english: He, Agni, kindled, good and wise, must be exalted in our song: Shine, thou of many forms, shine radiantly on us.

sanskrit: kṣapaḥ rājan uta tmanā agne vastoḥ uta uṣasaḥ saḥ tigma jambha rakṣasaḥ daha prati
english: O Agni, shining of thyself by night and when the morning breaks, Burn, thou whose teeth are sharp, against the Raksasas.

sanskrit: ava naḥ agne ūti bhiḥ gāyatrasya pra bharmaṇi viśvāsu dhīṣu vandya
english: Adorable in all our rites, favour us, Agni, with thine.aid, When the great hymn is chanted forth.

sanskrit: ā naḥ agne rayim bhara satrāsaham vareṇyam viśvāsu pr̥t su dustaram
english: Bring to us ever-conquering wealth, wealth, Agni, worthy of our choice, In all our frays invincible.

sanskrit: ā naḥ agne su cetunā rayim viśvāyu poṣasam mārḍīkam dhehi jīvase
english: Give us, O Agni, through thy grace wealth that supporteth all our life, Thy favour so that we may live.

sanskrit: pra pūtāḥ tigma śociṣe vācaḥ gotama agnaye bharasva sumna yuḥ giraḥ
english: O Gotama, desiring bliss present thy songs composed with care To Agni of the pointed flames.

sanskrit: yaḥ naḥ agne abhi dāsati anti dūre padīṣṭa saḥ asmākam it vr̥dhe bhava
english: May the man fall, O Agni, who near or afar assaileth us: Do thou increase and prosper us.

sanskrit: sahasra akṣaḥ vi carṣaṇiḥ agniḥ rakṣāṁsi sedhati hotā gr̥ṇīte ukthyaḥ
english: Keen and swift Agni, thousand-eyed, chaseth the Raksasas afar: He singeth, herald meet for lauds.

sanskrit: itthā hi some it made brahmā cakāra vardhanam śaviṣṭha vajrin ojasā pr̥thivyāḥ niḥ śaśāḥ ahim arcan anu sva rājyam
english: THUS in the Soma, in wild joy the Brahman hath exalted thee: Thou, mightiest It thunder-armed, hast driven by force he Dragon from the earth, lauding thine own imperial sway.

sanskrit: saḥ tvā amadat vr̥ṣā madaḥ somaḥ śyena ābhr̥taḥ sutaḥ yena vr̥tram niḥ at bhyaḥ jaghantha vajrin ojasā arcan anu sva rājyam
english: The mighty flowing Soma-draught, brought by the Hawk, hath gladdened thee, That in thy strength, O Thunderer, thou hast struck down Vr̥itra from the floods, lauding thine own imperial sway.

sanskrit: pra ihi abhi ihi dhr̥ṣṇuhi na te vajraḥ ni yaṁsate indra nr̥mṇam h i te śavaḥ hanaḥ vr̥tram jayāḥ apaḥ arcan anu sva rājyam
english: Go forward, meet the foe, be bold; thy bolt of thunder is not checked. Manliness, Indra, is thy might: stay Vr̥itra, make the waters thine, lauding thine own imperial sway.

sanskrit: niḥ indra bhūmyāḥ adhi vr̥tram jaghantha niḥ divaḥ sr̥ja marutvatīḥ ava jīva dhanyāḥ imāḥ apaḥ arcan anu sva rājyam
english: Thou smotest Vr̥itra from the earth, smotest him, Indra, from the sky. Let these life-fostering waters flow attended by the Marut host, lauding thine own imperial sway.

sanskrit: indraḥ vr̥trasya dodhataḥ sānum vajreṇa hīl̥itaḥ abhi kramya ava ji ghnate apaḥ sarmāya codayan arcan anu sva rājyam
english: The wrathful Indra with his bolt of thunder rushing on the foe, Smote fierce on trembling Vr̥itra's back, and loosed the waters free to run, lauding his own imperial sway.

sanskrit: adhi sānau ni jighnīate vajreṇa śata parvaṇā mandānaḥ indraḥ andhasaḥ sakhi bhyaḥ gātum icchati arcan anu sva rājyam
english: With hundred-jointed thunderbolt Indra hath struck him on the back, And, while rejoicing in the juice, seeketh prosperity for friends, lauding his own imperial sway.

sanskrit: indra tubhyam it adri vaḥ anuttam vajrin vīryam yat ha tyam māy inam mr̥gam tam oṁ iti tvam māyayā avadhīḥ arcan anu sva rājyam
english: Indra, unconquered might is thine, Thunderer, Caster of the Stone; For thou with thy surpassing power smotest to death the guileful beast, lauding thine own imperial sway.

sanskrit: vi te vajrāsaḥ asthiran navatim nāvyāḥ anu mahat te indra vīryam bāhvoḥ te balam hitam arcan anu sva rājyam
english: Far over ninety spacious floods thy thunderbolts were cast abroad: Great, Indra, is thy hero might, and strength is seated in thine arms, lauding thine own imperial sway.

sanskrit: sahasram sākam arcata pari stobhata viṁśatiḥ śatā enam anu anonavuḥ indrāya brahma ut yatam arcan anu sva rājyam
english: Laud him a thousand all at once, shout twenty forth the hymn of praise. Hundreds have sung aloud to him, to Indra hath the prayer been raised, lauding his own imperial sway.

sanskrit: indraḥ vr̥trasya taviṣīm niḥ ahan sahasā sahaḥ mahat tat asya paiṁsyam vr̥tram jaghanvān asr̥jat arcan anu sva rājyam
english: Indra hath smitten down the power of Vr̥itra,– might with stronger might. This was his manly exploit, he slew Vr̥itra and let loose the floods, lauding his own imperial sway.

sanskrit: ime cit tava manyave vepeteiti bhiyasā mahī yat indra vajrin ojasā vr̥tram marutvān avadhīḥ arcan anu sva rājyam
english: Yea, even this great Pair of Worlds trembled in terror at thy wrath, When, Indra, Thunderer, Marut-girt, thou slewest Vr̥itra in thy strength, lauding thine own imperial sway.

sanskrit: na vepasā na tanyatā indram vr̥traḥ vi bībhayat abhi enam vajraḥ āyasaḥ sahasra bhr̥ṣṭiḥ āyāta arcan anu sva rājyam
english: But Vr̥itra scared not Indra with his shaking or his thunder roar. On him that iron thunderbolt fell fiercely with its thousand points, lauding his own imperial sway.

sanskrit: yat vr̥tram tava ca aśanim vajreṇa sam ayodhayaḥ ahim indra jighāṁsataḥ divi te badbadhe śavaḥ arcan anu sva rājyam
english: Whenwith the thunder thou didst make thy dart and Vr̥itra meet in war, Thy might, O Indra, fain to slay the Dragon, was set firm in heaven, lauding thine own imperial sway.

sanskrit: abhi stane te adri vaḥ yat sthāḥ jagat ca rejate tvaṣṭā cit tava manyave indra vevijyate bhiyā arcan anu sva rājyam
english: When at thy shout, O Thunder-armed, each thing both fixed and moving shook, E'en Tvashṭar trembled at thy wrath and quaked with fear because of thee, lauding thine own imperial sway.

sanskrit: nahi nu yāt adhi imasi indram kaḥ vīryā paraḥ tasmin nr̥mṇam uta kratum devāḥ ojāṁsi sam dadhuḥ arcan anu sva rājyam
english: There is not, in our knowledge, one who passeth Indra in his strength: In him the Deities have stored manliness, insight, power and might, lauding his own imperial sway.

sanskrit: yām atharvā manuḥ pitā dadhyaṅ dhiyam atnata tasmin brahmāṇi pūrva thā indre ukthā sam agmata arcan anu sva rājyam
english: Still as of old, whatever rite Atharvan, Manus sire of all, Dadhyach performed, their prayer and praise united in that Indra meet, lauding his own imperial sway.

sanskrit: indraḥ madāya vavr̥dhe śavase vr̥tra hā nr̥ bhiḥ tam it mahat su ājiṣu uta īm arbhe havāmahe saḥ vājeṣu pra naḥ aviṣat
english: THE men have lifted Indra up, the Vr̥itra slayer, to joy and strength: Him, verily, we invocate in battles whether great or small: be he our aid in deeds of might.

sanskrit: asi hi vīra senyaḥ asi bhūri parādadiḥ asi dabhrasya cit vr̥dhaḥ yajamānāya śikṣasi sunvate bhūri te vasu
english: Thou, Hero, art a warrior, thou art giver of abundant spoil. Strengthening e'en the feeble, thou aidest the sacrificer, thou givest the offerer ample wealth.

sanskrit: yat ut īrate ājayaḥ dhr̥ṣṇave dhīyate dhanā yukṣva mada cyutā harī iti kam hanaḥ kam vasau dadhaḥ asmān indra vasau dadhaḥ
english: When war and battles are on foot, booty is laid before the bold. Yoke thou thy wildly-rushing Bays. Whom wilt thou slay and whom enrich? Do thou, O Indra, make us rich.

sanskrit: kratvā mahān anu svadham bhīmaḥ ā vavr̥dhe śavaḥ śriye r̥ṣvaḥ upākayoḥ ni śiprī hari vān dadhe hastayoḥ vajram āyasam
english: Mighty through wisdom, as he lists, terrible, he hath waxed in strength. Lord of Bay Steeds, strong-jawed, sublime, he in joined hands for glory's sake hath grasped his iron thunderbolt.

sanskrit: ā paprau pārthivam rajaḥ badbadhe rocanā divi na tvāvān indra kaḥ cana na jātaḥ na janiṣyate ati viśvam vavakṣitha
english: He filled the earthly atmosphere and pressed against the lights in heaven. None like thee ever hath been born, none, Indra, will be born like thee. Thou hast waxed mighty over all.

sanskrit: yaḥ aryaḥ marta bhojanam parādadāti dāśuṣe indraḥ asmabhyam śikṣatu vi bhaja bhūri te vasu bhakṣīya tava rādhasaḥ
english: May he who to the offerer gives the foeman's man-sustaining food, May Indra lend his aid to us. Deal forth-abundant is thy wealth-that in thy bounty I may share.

sanskrit: made made hi naḥ dadiḥ yūthā gavām r̥ju kratuḥ sam gr̥bhāya puru śatā ubhayāhastyā vasu śiśīhi rāyaḥ ā bhara
english: He, righteous-hearted, at each time of rapture gives us herds of kine. Gather in both thy hands for us treasures of many hundred sorts. Sharpen thou us, and bring us wealth.

sanskrit: mādayasva sute sacā śavase śūra rādhase vidma hi tvā puru vasum upa kāmān sasr̥jmahe atha naḥ avitā bhava
english: Refresh thee, Hero, with the juice outpoured for bounty and for strength. We know thee Lord of ample store, to thee have sent our hearts' desires: be therefore our Protector thou.

sanskrit: ete te indra jantavaḥ viśvam puṣyanti vāryam antaḥ hi khyaḥ janānām aryaḥ vedaḥ adāśuṣām teṣām naḥ vedaḥ ā bhara
english: These people, Indra, keep for thee all that is worthy of thy choice. Discover thou, as Lord, the wealth of men who offer up no gifts: bring thou to us this wealth of theirs.

sanskrit: upo iti su śr̥ṇuhi giraḥ magha van mā atathāḥ iva yadā naḥ sūnr̥tāvataḥ karaḥ āt arthayāse it yoja nu indra te harī iti
english: GRACIOUSLY listen to our songs, Maghavan, be not negligent. As thou hast made us full of joy and lettest us solicit thee, now, Indra, yoke thy two Bay Steeds.

sanskrit: akṣan amīmadanta hi ava priyāḥ adhūṣata astoṣata sva bhānavaḥ viprāḥ naviṣṭhayā matī yoja nu indra te harī iti
english: Well have they eaten and rejoiced; the friends have risen and passed away. The sages luminous in themselves have. praised thee with their latest hymn. Now, Indra, yoke thy two Bay Steeds.

sanskrit: su sandr̥śam tvā vayam magha van vandiṣīmahi pra nūnam pūrṇa vandhuraḥ stutaḥ yāhi vaśān anu yoja nu indra te harī iti
english: Maghavan, we will reverence thee who art so fair to look upon. Thus praised, according to our wish come now with richly laden car. Now, Indra, yoke thy two Bay Steeds.

sanskrit: saḥ gha tam vr̥ṣaṇam ratham adhi tiṣṭhāti govidam yaḥ pātram hāri yojanam pūrṇam indra ciketati yoja nu indra te harī iti
english: He will in very truth ascend the powerful car that finds the kine, Who thinks upon the well-filled bowl, the Tawny Coursers' harnesser. Now, Indra, yoke thy two Bay Steeds.

sanskrit: yuktaḥ te astu dakṣiṇaḥ uta savyaḥ śatakrato itiśata krato tena jāyām upa priyām mandānaḥ yāhi andhasaḥ yoja nu indra te harī iti
english: Let, Lord of Hundred Powers, thy Steeds be harnessed on the right and left. Therewith in rapture of the juice, draw near to thy beloved Spouse. Now, Indra, yoke thy two Bay Steeds.

sanskrit: yunajmi te brahmaṇā keśinā harī iti upa pra yāhi dadhiṣe gabhastyoḥ ut tvā sutāsaḥ rabhasāḥ amandiṣuḥ pūṣaṇ vān vajrin sam oṁ iti patnyā amadaḥ
english: With holy prayer I yoke thy long-maned pair of Bays: come hitherward; thou holdest them in both thy hands. The stirring draughts of juice outpoured have made thee glad: thou, Thunderer, hast rejoiced with Pûshan and thy Spouse.

sanskrit: aśva vati prathamaḥ goṣu gacchati supra āvīḥ indra martyaḥ tava ūti bhiḥ tam it pr̥ṇakṣi vasunā bhavīyasā sindhum āpaḥ yathā abhitaḥ vi cetasaḥ
english: INDRA, the mortal man well guarded by thine aid goes foremost in the wealth of horses and of kine. With amplest wealth thou fillest him, as round about the waters clearly seen afar fill Sindhu full.

sanskrit: āpaḥ na devīḥ upa yanti hotriyam avaḥ paśyanti vi tatam yathā rajaḥ prācaiḥ devāsaḥ pra nayanti deva yum brahma priyam joṣayante varāḥ iva
english: The heavenly Waters come not nigh the priestly bowl: they but look down and see how far mid-air is spread: The Deities conduct the pious man to them: like suitors they delight in him who loveth prayer.

sanskrit: adhi dvayoḥ adadhāḥ ukthyam vacaḥ yata srucā mithunā yā saparyataḥ asam yattaḥ vrate te kṣeti puṣyati bhadrā śaktiḥ yajamānāya sunvate
english: Praiseworthy blessing hast thou laid upon the pair who with uplifted ladle serve thee, man and wife. Unchecked he dwells and prospers in thy law: thy power brings blessing to the sacrificer pouring gifts.

sanskrit: āt aṅgirāḥ prathamam dadhire vayaḥ iddha agnayaḥ śamyā ye su kr̥tyayā sarvam paṇeḥ sam avindanta bhojanam aśva vantam go mantam ā paśum naraḥ
english: First the Angirases won themselves vital power, whose fires were kindled through good deeds and sacrifice. The men together found the Paṇi's hoarded wealth, the cattle, and the wealth in horses and in kine.

sanskrit: yajñaiḥ atharvā prathamaḥ pathaḥ tate tataḥ sūryaḥ vrata pāḥ venaḥ ā ajani ā gāḥ ājat uśanā kavyaḥ sacā yamasya jātam amr̥tam yajāmahe
english: Atharvan first by sacrifices laid the paths then, guardian of the Law, sprang up the loving Sun. Uṣanâ Kâvya straightway hither drove the kine. Let us with offerings honour Yama's deathless birth.

sanskrit: barhiḥ vā yat su apatyāya vr̥jyate arkaḥ vā ślokam āghoṣate divi grāvā yatra vadati kāruḥ ukthyaḥ tasya it indraḥ abhi pitveṣu raṇyati
english: When sacred grass is trimmed to aid the auspicious work, or the hymn makes its voice of praise sound to the sky. Where the stone rings as'twere a singer skilled in laud, --Indra in truth delights when these come near to him.

sanskrit: asāvi somaḥ indra te śaviṣṭha dhr̥ṣṇo iti ā gahi ā tvā pr̥ṇaktu indriyam rajaḥ sūryaḥ na raśmi bhiḥ
english: The Soma hath been pressed for thee, O Indra; mightiest, bold One, come. May Indra-vigour fill thee full, as the Sun fills mid-air with rays.

sanskrit: indram it harī vahataḥ apratidhr̥ṣṭa śavasam r̥ṣīṇām ca stutīḥ upa yajñam ca mānuṣāṇām
english: His pair of Tawny Coursers bring Indra of unresisted might Hither to R̥ishis' songs of praise and sacrifice performed by men.

sanskrit: iti arvācīnam su te manaḥ grāvā kr̥ṇotu vagnunā
english: Slayer of Vr̥itra, mount thy car; thy Bay Steeds have been yoked by prayer. May, with its voice, the pressing-stone draw thine attention hitherward.

sanskrit: imam indra sutam piba jyeṣṭham amartyam madam śukrasya tvā abhi akṣaran dhārāḥ r̥tasya sādane
english: This poured libation, Indra, drink, immortal, gladdening, excellent. Streams of the bright have flowed to thee here at the seat of holy Law.

sanskrit: indrāya nūnam arcata ukthāni ca bravītana sutāḥ amatsuḥ indavaḥ jyeṣṭham namasyata sahaḥ
english: Sing glory now to Indra, say to him your solemn eulogies. The drops poured forth have made him glad: pay reverence to his might supreme.

sanskrit: nakiḥ tvat rathītaraḥ harī yat indra yacchase nakiḥ tvā anu majmanā nakiḥ su aśvaḥ ānaśe
english: When, Indra, thou dost yoke thy Steeds, there is no better charioteer: None hath surpassed thee in thy might, none with good steeds o'ertaken thee.

sanskrit: yaḥ ekaḥ it vi dayate vasu martāya dāśuṣe īśānaḥ aprati skutaḥ indraḥ aṅga
english: He who alone bestoweth on mortal man who offereth gifts, The ruler of resistless power, is Indra, sure.

sanskrit: kadā martam arādhasam padā kṣumpam iva sphurat kadā naḥ śuśravat giraḥ indraḥ aṅga
english: When will he trample, like a weed, the man who hath no gift for him? When, verily, will Indra hear our songs of praise?

sanskrit: yaḥ cit hi tvā bahu bhyaḥ ā suta vān āvivāsati ugram tat patyate śavaḥ indraḥ aṅga
english: He who with Soma juice prepared amid the many honours thee,– Verily Indra gains thereby tremendous might.

sanskrit: svādoḥ itthā viṣu vataḥ madhvaḥ pibanti gauryaḥ yāḥ indreṇa sa yāvarīḥ vr̥ṣṇā madanti śobhase vasvīḥ anu sva rājyam
english: The juice of Soma thus diffused, sweet to the taste, the bright cows drink, Who for the sake of splendour close to mighty Indra's side rejoice, good in their own supremacy.

sanskrit: tāḥ asya pr̥śana yuvaḥ somam śrīṇanti pr̥śnayaḥ priyāḥ indrasya dhenavaḥ vajram hinvanti sāyakam vasvīḥ anu sva rājyam
english: Craving his touch the dappled kine mingle the Soma with their milk. The milch-kine dear to Indra send forth his death-dealing thunderbolt, good in their own supremacy.

sanskrit: tāḥ asya namasā sahaḥ saparyanti pra cetasaḥ vratāni asya saścire purūṇi pūrva cittaye vasvīḥ anu sva rājyam
english: With veneration, passing wise, honouring his victorious might, They follow close his many laws to win them due preeminence, good in their own supremacy.

sanskrit: indraḥ dadhīcaḥ astha bhiḥ vr̥trāṇi aprati skutaḥ jaghāna navatīḥ nava
english: With bones of Dadhyac for his arms, Indra, resistless in attack, Struck nine-and-ninety Vr̥itras dead.

sanskrit: icchan aśvasya yat śiraḥ parvateṣu apa śritam tat vidat śaryaṇāvati
english: He, searching for the horse's head, removed among the mountains, found At Ṣaryaṇâvân what he sought.

sanskrit: atra aha goḥ amanvata nāma tvaṣṭuḥ apīcyam itthā candramasaḥ gr̥he
english: Then verily they recognized the essential form of Tvashṭar's Bull, Here in the mansion of the Moon.

sanskrit: kaḥ adya yuṅkte dhuri gāḥ r̥tasya śimī vataḥ bhāminaḥ duḥ hr̥ṇāyūn āsan iṣūn hatsu asaḥ maya bhūn yaḥ eṣām bhr̥tyām r̥ṇadhat saḥ jīvāt
english: Who yokes to-day unto the pole of Order the strong and passionate steers of checkless spirit, With shaft-armed mouths, heart-piercing, health-bestowing? Long shall he live who richly pays their service.

sanskrit: kaḥ īṣate tujyate kaḥ bibhāya kaḥ maṁsate santam indram kaḥ anti kaḥ tokāya kaḥ ibhāya uta rāye adhi bravat tanve kaḥ janāya
english: Who fleeth forth? who suffereth? who feareth? Who knoweth Indra present, Indra near us? Who sendeth benediction on his offspring, his household, wealth and person, and the People?

sanskrit: kaḥ agnim īṭe haviṣā ghr̥tena srucā yajātai r̥tu bhiḥ dhruvebhiḥ kasmai devāḥ ā vahān āśu homa kaḥ maṁsate vīti hotraḥ su devaḥ
english: Who with poured oil and offering honours Agni, with ladle worships at appointed seasons? To whom to the Gods bring oblation quickly? What offerer, God-favoured, knows him thoroughly?

sanskrit: tvam aṅga pra śaṁsiṣaḥ devaḥ śaviṣṭha martyam na tvat anyaḥ magha van asti marḍitā indra bravīmi te vacaḥ
english: Thou as a God, O Mightiest, verily blessest mortal man. O Maghavan, there is no comforter but thou: Indra, I speak my words to thee.

sanskrit: mā te rādhāṁsi mā te ūtayaḥ vaso iti asmān kadā cana dabhan viśvā ca naḥ upa mimīhi mānuṣa vasūn i carṣaṇi bhyaḥ ā
english: Let not thy bounteous gifts, let not thy saving help fail us, good Lord, at any time; And measure out to us, thou lover of mankind, all riches hitherward from men.

sanskrit: pra ye śumbhante janayaḥ na saptayaḥ yāman rudrasya sūnavaḥ su daṁsasaḥ rodasī hi marutaḥ cakrire vr̥dhe madanti vīrāḥ vidatheṣu ghr̥ṣvayaḥ
english: THEY who are glancing forth, like women, on their way, doers of mighty deeds, swift racers, Rudra's Sons, The Maruts have made heaven and earth increase and grow: in sacrifices they delight, the strong and wild.

sanskrit: te ukṣitāsaḥ mahimānam āśata divi rudrāsaḥ adhi cakrire sadaḥ arcantaḥ arkam janayantaḥ indriyam adhi śriyaḥ dadhire pr̥śni mātaraḥ
english: Grown to their perfect strength greatness have they attained; the Rudras have established their abode in heaven. Singing their song of praise and generating might, they have put glory on, the Sons whom Prani bare.

sanskrit: go mātaraḥ yat śubhayante añji bhiḥ tanūṣu śubhrāḥ dadhire virukmataḥ bādhante viśvam abhi mātinam apa vartmāni eṣām anu rīyate ghr̥tam
english: When, Children of the Cow, they shine in bright attire, and on their fair limbs lay their golden ornaments, They drive away each adversary from their path, and, following their traces, fatness floweth down,

sanskrit: vi ye bhrājante su makhāsaḥ r̥ṣṭi bhiḥ pra cyavayantaḥ acyutā cit ojasā manaḥ juvaḥ yat marutaḥ ratheṣu ā vr̥ṣa vrātāsaḥ pr̥ṣatīḥ ayugdhvam
english: When, mighty Warriors, ye who glitter with your spears, o'erthrowing with your strength e'en what is ne'er o'erthrown, When, O ye Maruts, ye the host that send the rain, had harnessed to your cars the thought-fleet spotted deer.

sanskrit: pra yat ratheṣu pr̥ṣatīḥ ayugdhvam vāje adrim marutaḥ raṁhayantaḥ uta aruṣasya vi syanti dhārāḥ carma iva uda bhiḥ vi undanti bhūma
english: When ye have harnessed to your cars the spotted deer, urging the thunderbolt, O Maruts, to the fray, Forth rush the torrents of the dark red stormy cloud, and moisten, like a skin, the earth with waterfloods.

sanskrit: ā vaḥ vahantu saptayaḥ raghu syadaḥ raghu patvānaḥ pra jigāta bāhu bhiḥ sīdatā barhiḥ uru vaḥ sadaḥ kr̥tam mādayadhvam marutaḥ madhvaḥ andhasaḥ
english: Let your swift-gliding coursers bear you hitherward with their fleet pinions. Come ye forward with your arms. Sit on the grass; a wide scat hath been made for you: delight yourselves, O Maruts, in the pleasant food.

sanskrit: te avardhanta sva tavasaḥ mahi tvanā ā nākam tasthuḥ uru cakrire sadaḥ viṣṇuḥ yat ha āvat vr̥ṣaṇam mada cyutam vayaḥ na sdan adhi barhiṣi priye
english: Strong in their native strength to greatness have they grown, stepped to the firmament and made their dwelling wide. When Vishṇu saved the Soma bringing wild delight, the Maruts sate like birds on their dear holy grass.

sanskrit: śūrāḥ iva it yuyudhayah na jagmayaḥ śravasyavaḥ na pr̥tanāsu yetire bhayante viśvā bhuvanā marut bhyaḥ rājānaḥ iva tveṣa sandr̥śaḥ naraḥ
english: In sooth like heroes fain for fight they rush about, like combatants fame-seeking have they striven in war. Before the Maruts every creature is afraid: the men are like to Kings, terrible to behold.

sanskrit: tvaṣṭā yat vajram su kr̥tam hiraṇyayam sahasra bhr̥ṣṭim su apāḥ avartayat dhatte indraḥ nari apāṁsi kartave ahan vr̥tram niḥ apām aubjat arṇavam
english: When Tyastar deft of hand had turned the thunderbolt, golden, with thousand edges, fashioned more skilfully, Indra received it to perform heroic deeds. Vr̥itra he slew, and forced the flood of water forth.

sanskrit: ūrdhvam nunudre avatam te ojasā dādr̥hāṇam cit bibhiduḥ vi parvatam dhamantaḥ vāṇam marutaḥ su dānavah made somasya raṇyāni cakrire
english: They with their vigorous strength pushed the well up on high, and clove the cloud in twain though it was passing strong. The Maruts, bounteous Givers, sending forth their voice, in the wild joy of Soma wrought their glorious deeds.

sanskrit: jihmam nunudre avatam tayā diśā asiñcan utsam gotamāya tr̥ṣṇa je ā gacchanti īm avasā citra bhānavaḥ kāmam viprasya tarpayanta dhāma bhiḥ
english: They drave the cloud transverse directed hitherward, and poured the fountain forth for thirsting Gotama. Shining with varied light they come to him with help: they with their might fulfilled the longing of the sage.

sanskrit: yā vaḥ śarma śaśamānāya santi tri dhātūni dāśuṣe yacchata adhi asmabhyam tāni marutaḥ vi yanta rayim naḥ dhatta vr̥ṣaṇaḥ su vīram
english: The shelters which ye have for him who lauds you, bestow them threefold on the man who offers. Extend the same boons unto us, ye Maruts. Give us, O Heroes, wealth with noble offspring.

sanskrit: marutaḥ yasya hi kṣaye pātha divaḥ vi mahasaḥ saḥ su gopātamaḥ janaḥ
english: THE best of guardians hath that man within whose dwelling place ye drink, O Maruts, giants of the sky.

sanskrit: yajñaiḥ vā yajña vāhasaḥ viprasya vā matīnām marutaḥ śr̥ṇuta havam
english: Honoured with sacrifice or with the worship of the sages' hymns, O Maruts, listen to the call.

sanskrit: uta vā yasya vājinaḥ anu vipram atakṣata saḥ gantā go mati vraje
english: Yea, the strong man to whom ye have vouchsafed to give a sage, shall move Into a stable rich in kine.

sanskrit: asya vīrasya barhiṣi sutaḥ somaḥ diviṣṭiṣu uktham madaḥ ca śasyate
english: Upon this hero's sacred grass Soma is poured in daily rites: Praise and delight are sung aloud.

sanskrit: asya śroṣantu ā bhuvaḥ viśvāḥ yaḥ carṣaṇīḥ abhi sūram cit sasruṣīḥ iṣaḥ
english: Let the strong Maruts hear him, him surpassing all men: strength be his That reaches even to the Sun.

sanskrit: pūrvībhiḥ hi dadāśima śarat bhiḥ marutaḥ vayam avaḥ bhiḥ carṣaṇīnām
english: For, through the swift Gods' loving help, in many an autumn, Maruts, we Have offered up our sacrifice.

sanskrit: su bhagaḥ saḥ pra yajyavaḥ marutaḥ astu martyaḥ yasya prayāṁsi parṣatha
english: Fortunate shall that mortal be, O Maruts most adorable, Whose offerings ye bear away.

sanskrit: śaśamānasya vā naraḥ svedasya satya śavasaḥ vida kāmasya venataḥ
english: O Heroes truly strong, ye know the toil of him who sings your praise, The heart's desire of him who loves.

sanskrit: yūyam tat satya śavasaḥ āviḥ karta mahi tvanā vidhyata vi dyutā rakṣaḥ
english: O ye of true strength, make this thing manifest by your greatness – strike The demon with your thunderbolt.

sanskrit: gūhata guhyam tamaḥ vi yāta viśvam atriṇam jyotiḥ karta yat uśmas i
english: Conceal the horrid darkness, drive far from us each devouring fiend. Create the light for which we long.

sanskrit: pra tvakṣasaḥ pra tavasaḥ vi rapśinaḥ anānatāḥ avithurāḥ r̥jīṣ iṇaḥ juṣṭa tamāsaḥ nr̥ tamāsaḥ añji bhiḥ vi ānajre ke cit usrāivastr̥bhiḥ
english: LOUD Singers, never humbled, active, full of strength, immovable, impetuous, manliest, bestbeloved, They have displayed themselves with glittering ornaments, a few in number only, like the heavens with stars.

sanskrit: upa hvareṣu yat acidhvam yayim vayaḥ iva marutaḥ kena cit pathā ścotanti kośāḥ upa vaḥ ratheṣu ā ghr̥tam ukṣata madhu varṇam arcate
english: When, Maruts, on the steeps ye pile the moving cloud, ye are like birds on whatsoever path it be. Clouds everywhere shed forth the rain upon your cars. Drop fatness, honey-hued, for him who sings your praise.

sanskrit: pra eṣām ajmeṣu vithurāiva rejate bhūmiḥ yāmeṣu yat ha yuñjate śubhe te krīl̥ayaḥ dhunayaḥ bhrājat r̥ṣṭayaḥ svayam mahi tvam panayanta dhūtayaḥ
english: Earth at their racings trembles as if weak and worn, when on their ways they yoke their cars for victory. They, sportive, loudly roaring, armed with glittering spears, shakers of all, themselves admire their mightiness.

sanskrit: saḥ hi sva sr̥t pr̥ṣat aśvaḥ yuvā gaṇaḥ ayā īśānaḥ taviṣī bhiḥ āv r̥taḥ asi satyaḥ r̥ṇa yāvā anedyaḥ asyāḥ dhiyaḥ pra avitā atha vr̥ṣā gaṇaḥ
english: Self-moving is that youthful band, with spotted steeds; thus it hath lordly sway, endued with power and might. Truthful art thou, and blameless, searcher out of sin: so thou, Strong Host, wilt be protector of this prayer.

sanskrit: pituḥ pratnasya janmanā vadāmasi somasya jihvā pra jigāti cakṣasā yat īm indram śami r̥kvāṇaḥ āśata āt it nāmāni yajñiyāni dadhire
english: We speak by our descent from our primeval Sire; our tongue, when we behold the Soma, stirs itself. When, shouting, they had joined Indra in toil of fight, then only they obtained their sacrificial names.

sanskrit: śriyase kam bhānu bhiḥ sam mimikṣire te raśmi bhiḥ te r̥kva bhiḥ su khādayaḥ te vāśī mantaḥ iṣmiṇaḥ abhīravaḥ vidre priyasya mārutasya dhāmnaḥ
english: Splendours they gained for glory, they who wear bright rings; rays they obtained, and men to celebrate their praise. Armed with their swords, impetuous and fearing naught, they have possessed the Maruts' own beloved home.

sanskrit: ā vidyunmat bhiḥ marutaḥ su arkaiḥ rathebhiḥ yāta r̥ṣṭimat bhiḥ aśva parṇaiḥ ā varṣiṣṭhayā naḥ iṣā vayaḥ na paptata su māyāḥ
english: COME hither, Maruts, on your lightning laden cars, sounding with sweet songs, armed with lances, winged with steeds. Fly unto us with noblest food, like birds, O ye of mighty power.

sanskrit: te aruṇebhiḥ varam ā piśaṅgaiḥ śubhe kam yānti rathatūḥ bhiḥ aśvaiḥ rukmaḥ na citraḥ svadhiti vān pavyā rathasya jaṅghananta bhūma
english: With their red-hued or, haply, tawny coursers which speed their chariots on, they come for glory. Brilliant like gold is he who holds the thunder. Earth have they smitten with the chariot's felly.

sanskrit: śriye kam vaḥ adhi tanūṣu vāśīḥ medhā vanā na kr̥ṇavante ūrdhvā yuṣmabhyam kam marutaḥ su jātāḥ tuvi dyumnāsaḥ dhanayante adrim
english: For beauty ye have swords upon your bodies. As they stir woods so may they stir our spirits. For your sake, O ye Maruts very mighty and well-born, have they set the stone, in motion.

sanskrit: ahāni gr̥dhrāḥ pari ā vaḥ ā aguḥ imām dhiyam vārkāryām ca devīm brahma kr̥ṇvantaḥ gotamāsaḥ arkaiḥ ūrdhvam nunudre utsa dhim pibadhyai
english: The days went round you and came back O yearners, back, to this prayer and to this solemn worship. The Gotamas making their prayer with singing have pushed the well's lid up to drink the water.

sanskrit: etat tyat na yojanam aceti sasvaḥ ha yat marutaḥ gotamaḥ vaḥ paśyan hiraṇya cakrān ayaḥ daṁṣṭrān vi dhāvataḥ varāhūn
english: No hymn way ever known like this aforetime which Gotama sang forth for you, O Maruts, What time upon your golden wheels he saw you, wild boars rushing about with tusks of iron.

sanskrit: eṣā syā vaḥ marutaḥ anu bhartrī prati stobhati vāghataḥ na vāṇī astobhayat vr̥thā āsām anu svadhām gabhastyoḥ
english: To you this freshening draught of Soma rusheth, O Maruts, like the voice of one who prayeth. It rusheth freely from our hands as these. libations wont to flow.

sanskrit: ā naḥ bhadrāḥ kratavaḥ yantu viśvataḥ adabdhāsaḥ apari itāsaḥ ut bhidaḥ devāḥ naḥ yathā sadam it vr̥dhe asan apra āyuvaḥ rakṣitāraḥ dive dive
english: MAY powers auspicious come to us from every side, never deceived, unhindered, and victorious, That the Gods ever may be with us for our gain, our guardians day by day unceasing in their care.

sanskrit: devānām bhadrā su matiḥ r̥ju yatām devānām rātiḥ abhi naḥ ni vartatām devānām sakhyam upa sedima vayam devāḥ naḥ āyuḥ pra tirantu jīvase
english: May the auspicious favour of the Gods be ours, on us descend the bounty of the righteous Gods. The friendship of the Gods have we devoutly sought: so may the Gods extend our life that we may live.

sanskrit: tān pūrvayā ni vidā hūmahe vayam bhagam mitram aditim dakṣam asridham aryamaṇam varuṇam somam aśvinā sarasvatī naḥ su bhagā mayaḥ karat
english: We call them hither with a hymn of olden time, Bhaga, the friendly Daksha, Mitra, Aditi, Aryaman, Varuṇa, Soma, the Aṣvins. May Sarasvatî, auspicious, grant felicity.

sanskrit: tat naḥ vātaḥ mayaḥ bhu vātu bheṣajam tat mātā pr̥thivī tat pitā dyauḥ tat grāvāṇaḥ soma sutaḥ mayaḥ bhuvaḥ tat aśvinā śr̥ṇutam dhiṣṇyā yuvam
english: May the Wind waft to us that pleasant medicine, may Earth our Mother give it, and our Father Heaven, And the joy-giving stones that press the Soma's juice. Aṣvins, may ye, for whom our spirits long, hear this.

sanskrit: tam īśānam jagataḥ tasthuṣaḥ patim dhiyam jinvam avase hūmahe vayam pūṣā naḥ yathā vedasam asat vr̥dhe rakṣitā pāyuḥ adabdhaḥ svastaye
english: Him we invoke for aid who reigns supreme, the Lord of all that stands or moves, inspirer of the soul, That Pûshan may promote the increase of our wealth, our keeper and our guard infallible for our good.

sanskrit: svasti naḥ indraḥ vr̥ddha śravāḥ svasti naḥ pūṣā viśva vedāḥ svasti naḥ tārkṣyaḥ ariṣṭa nemiḥ svasti naḥ br̥haspatiḥ dadhātu
english: Illustrious far and wide, may Indra prosper us: may Pûshan prosper us, the Master of all wealth. May Târkshya with uninjured fellies prosper us: Br̥ihaspati vouchsafe to us prosperity.

sanskrit: pr̥ṣat aśvāḥ marutaḥ pr̥śni mātaraḥ śubham yāvānaḥ vidatheṣu jagmayaḥ agni jihvāḥ manavaḥ sūra cakṣasaḥ viśve naḥ devāḥ avasā ā gaman iha
english: The Maruts, Sons of Prani, borne by spotted steeds, moving in glory, oft visiting holy rites, Sages whose tongue is Agni, brilliant as the Sun,– hither let all the Gods for our protection come.

sanskrit: bhadram karṇebhiḥ śr̥ṇuyāma devāḥ bhadram paśyema akṣa bhiḥ yajatrāḥ sth iraiḥ aṅgaiḥ tustu vāṁsaḥ tanūbhiḥ vi aśema deva hitam yat āyuḥ
english: Gods, may we with our ears listen to what is good, and with our eyes see what is good, ye Holy Ones. With limbs and bodies firm may we extolling you attain the term of life appointed by the Gods.

sanskrit: śatam it nu śaradaḥ anti devāḥ yatra naḥ cakra jarasam tanūnām putrāsaḥ yatra pitaraḥ bhavanti mā naḥ madhyā ririṣata āyuḥ gantoḥ
english: A hundred autumns stand before us, O ye Gods, within whose space ye bring our bodies to decay; Within whose space our sons become fathers in turn. Break ye not in the midst our course of fleeting life.

sanskrit: aditiḥ dyauḥ aditiḥ antarikṣam aditiḥ mātā saḥ pitā saḥ putraḥ viśve devāḥ aditiḥ pañca janāḥ aditiḥ jātam aditiḥ jani tvam
english: Aditi is the heaven, Aditi is mid-air, Aditi is the Mother and the Sire and Son. Aditi is all Gods, Aditi five-classed men, Aditi all that hath been bom and shall be born.

sanskrit: r̥ju nītī naḥ varuṇaḥ mitraḥ nayatu vidvān aryamā devaiḥ sa joṣāḥ
english: MAY Varuṇa with guidance straight, and Mitra lead us, he who knows, And Aryaman in accord with Gods.

sanskrit: te hi vasvaḥ vasavānāḥ te apra mūrāḥ mahaḥ bhiḥ vratā rakṣante viśvāhā
english: For they are dealers forth of wealth, and, not deluded, with their might Guard evermore the holy laws.

sanskrit: te asmabhyam śarma yaṁsan amr̥tāḥ martyebhyaḥ bādhamānāḥ apa dviṣaḥ
english: Shelter may they vouchsafe to us, Immortal Gods to mortal men, Chasing our enemies away.

sanskrit: vi naḥ pathaḥ suvitāya ciyantu indraḥ marutaḥ pūṣā bhagaḥ vandyāsaḥ
english: May they mark out our paths to bliss, Indra, the Maruts, Pûshan, and Bhaga, the Gods to be adored.

sanskrit: uta naḥ dhiyaḥ go agrāḥ pūṣan viṣṇo uti eva yāvaḥ karta naḥ svasti mataḥ
english: Yea, Pûshan, Vishṇu, ye who run your course, enrich our hymns with kine; Bless us with all prosperity.

sanskrit: madhu vātāḥ r̥tayate madhu kṣaranti sindhavaḥ mādhvīḥ naḥ santu oṣadhīḥ
english: The winds waft sweets, the rivers pour sweets for the man who keeps the Law So may the plants be sweet for us.

sanskrit: madhu naktam uta uṣasaḥ madhu mat pārthivam rajaḥ madhu dyauḥ astu naḥ pitā
english: Sweet be the night and sweet the dawns, sweet the terrestrial atmosphere; Sweet be our Father Heaven to us.

sanskrit: madhu mān naḥ vanaspatiḥ madhu mān astu sūryaḥ mādhvīḥ gāvaḥ bhavantu naḥ
english: May the tall tree be full of sweets for us, and full of sweets the Sun: May our milch-kine be sweet for us.

sanskrit: śam naḥ mitraḥ śam varuṇaḥ śam naḥ bhavatu aryamā śam naḥ indraḥ br̥haspatiḥ śam naḥ viṣṇuḥ uru kramaḥ
english: Be Mitra gracious unto us, and Varuṇa and Aryaman: Indra, Br̥ihaspati be kind, and Vishṇu of the mighty stride.

sanskrit: tvam soma pra cikitaḥ manīṣā tvam rajiṣṭham anu neṣi panthām tava pra nītī pitaraḥ naḥ indo iti deveṣu ratnam abhajanta dhīrāḥ
english: Thou, Soma, art preeminent for wisdom; along the straightest path thou art our leader. Our wise forefathers by thy guidance, Indu, dealt out among the Gods their share of treasure.

sanskrit: tvam soma kratu bhiḥ su kratuḥ bhūḥ tvam dakṣaiḥ su dakṣaḥ viśva vedāḥ tvam vr̥ṣā vr̥ṣa tvebhiḥ mahi tvā dyumnebhiḥ dyumnī abhavaḥ nr̥ cakṣāḥ
english: Thou by thine insight art most wise, O Soma, strong by thine energies and all possessing, Mighty art thou by all thy powers and greatness, by glories art thou glorious, guide of mortals.

sanskrit: rājñaḥ nu te varuṇasya vratāni br̥hat gabhīram tava soma dhāma śuciḥ tvam asi priyaḥ na mitraḥ dakṣāyyaḥ aryamāiva asi soma
english: Thine are King Varuṇa's eternal statutes, lofty and deep, O Soma, is thy glory. All-pure art thou like Mitra the beloved, adorable, like Aryaman, O Soma.

sanskrit: yā te dhāmāni divi yā pr̥thivyām yā parvateṣu oṣadhīṣu ap su tebhiḥ naḥ viśvaiḥ su manāḥ ahel̥an rājan soma prati havyā gr̥bhāya
english: With all thy glories on the earth, in heaven, on mountains, in the plants, and in the waters,– With all of these, well-pleased and not in anger, accept, O royal Soma, our oblations.

sanskrit: tvam soma asi sat patiḥ tvam rājā uta vr̥tra hā tvam bhadraḥ asi kratuḥ
english: Thou, Soma, art the Lord of heroes, King, yea, Vr̥itra-slayer thou: Thou art auspicious energy.

sanskrit: tvam ca soma naḥ vaśaḥ jīvātum na marāmahe priya stotraḥ vanaspatiḥ
english: And, Soma, let it be thy wish that we may live and may not die: Praise-loving Lord of plants art thou.

sanskrit: tvam soma mahe bhagam tvam yūne r̥ta yate dakṣam dadhāsi jīvase
english: To him who keeps the law, both old and young, thou givest happiness, And energy that he may live.

sanskrit: tvam naḥ soma viśvataḥ rakṣa rājan agha yataḥ na riṣyet tvāvataḥ sakhā
english: Guard us, King Soma, on all sides from him who threatens us: never let The friend of one like thee be harmed.

sanskrit: soma yāḥ te mayaḥ bhuvaḥ ūtayaḥ santi dāśuṣe tābhiḥ naḥ avitā bhava
english: With those delightful aids which thou hast, Soma, for the worshipper,– Even with those protect thou us.

sanskrit: imam yajñam idam vacaḥ jujuṣāṇaḥ upa āgahi soma tvam naḥ vr̥dhe bhava
english: Accepting this our sacrifice and this our praise, O Soma, come, And be thou nigh to prosper us.

sanskrit: soma gīḥ bhiḥ tvā vayam vardhayāmaḥ vacaḥ vidaḥ su mr̥l̥īkaḥ naḥ ā viśa
english: Well-skilled in speech we magnify thee, Soma, with our sacred songs: Come thou to us, most gracious One.

sanskrit: gaya sphānaḥ amīva hā vasu vit puṣṭi vardhanaḥ su mitraḥ soma naḥ bhava
english: Enricher, healer of disease, wealth-finder, prospering our store, Be, Soma, a good Friend to us.

sanskrit: soma rarandhi naḥ hr̥di gāvaḥ na yavaseṣu ā maryaḥ iva sve okye
english: Soma, be happy in our heart, as milch-kine in the grassy meads, As a young man in his own house.

sanskrit: devayuvaṃ viśvavārāmiti / upastautyevaināmetanmahayatyeva yadāha devayuvaṃ viśvavārāmitīḍāmahai devāṃ īḍenyānnamasyāma namasyānyajāma yajñiyānitīḍāmahai tāndevānya īḍenyā namasyāma tānye namasyā yajāma yajñiyāniti manuṣyā vā īḍenyāḥ pitaro namasyā devā yajñiyāḥ //
english: [He continues],'--(the spoon which is) devoted to the gods, possessed of all boons,' he praises, he magnifies it when he says 'devoted to the gods, possessed of all boons.'--'Let us praise the gods, the praiseworthy! let us adore the adorable! let us worship the worshipful!' that is, 'let us praise those gods who are praiseworthy! let us adore those who are adorable! let us worship those who are worthy of worship!' the praiseworthy, to wit, are the men, the adorable the fathers, and the worshipful the gods.

sanskrit: parābhūtā vai tā evamevaitadyā imāḥ prajā aparābhūtatstā yajña ābhajati manuṣyānanu paśavo devānanu vayāṃsyoṣadhayo vanaspatayo yadidaṃ kiñcaivamu tatsarvaṃ yajña ābhaktam //
english: For, indeed, the creatures that are not allowed to take part in the sacrifice are forlorn; and thereforehe makes those creatures here on earth that are not forlorn, take part in the sacrifice: behind the men are the beasts, and behind the gods are the birds, the plants, and the trees; and thus all that here exists is made to take part in the sacrifice.

sanskrit: tā vā etāḥ / nava vyāhṛtayo bhavanti naveme puruṣe prāṇā etānevāsminnetaddadhāti tasmānnava vyāhṛtayo bhavanti //
english: These same (preceding formulas) are nine utterances; for nine, in number, are those breaths (or vital airs) in man , and these he thereby puts into him (the sacrificer): for this reason there are nine utterances.

sanskrit: yajño ha devebhyo 'pacakrāma /
english: The sacrifice fled away from the gods.

sanskrit: taṃ devā anvamantrayantā naḥśṛṇūpa na āvartasveti so 'stu tathetyeva devānupāvavarta tenopāvṛttena devā ayajanta teneṣṭvaitadabhavanyadidaṃ devāḥ //
english: The gods called out after it, 'Listen (a-sru) to us ! come back to us!' It replied, 'So be it!' and returned to the gods; and with what had thus returned to them, the gods worshipped; and by worshipping with it they became the gods they now are.

sanskrit: yajñamevaitadanumantrayata ā naḥ śṛnūpa na āvartasvetyatha yatpratyāśrāvayati yajña evaitadupāvartate 'stu tatheti tenopāvṛttena retasā bhūtenartvijaḥ sampradāyaṃ caranti yajamānena paro 'kṣṃ yathā pūrṇapātreṇa sampradāyaṃ careyurevamanenartvijaḥ sampradāyaṃ caranti tadvācaivaitatsampradāyaṃ caranti vāgghi yajño vāgu hi retastadetenaivaitatsampradāyaṃ caranti //
english: Now when he (the Adhvaryu) calls (on the Âgnîdhra), he thereby calls after the sacrifice, 'Listen to us! come back to us!' and when he (the Âgnîdhra) responds, then the sacrifice comes back, saying 'so be it!' and with it, thus passing over to them, as with seed , the priests carry on the tradition, imperceptibly to the sacrificer; for even as people hand on from one to the other a full vessel , inthe same way they (the priests) hand down that (sacrifice) from one to the other. They hand it down by means of speech, for the sacrifice is speech (prayer), and speech is seed: therefore they keep up the tradition by means of it.

sanskrit: so 'nubrūhītyevoktvādhvaryuḥ / nāpavyāharenno eva hotāpavyāharedāśrāvayatyadhvaryustadagnīdhaṃ yajña upāvartate //
english: After he has said (to the Hotri), 'Recite!' the Adhvaryu must utter nothing improper (worldly); neither must the Hotri utter anything improper. The Adhvaryu utters his call: thereby the sacrifice passes on to the Âgnîdhra.

sanskrit: so 'gninnāpavyāharet /
english: The Âgnîdhra must utter nothing improper until his response.

sanskrit: ā pratyāśrāvaṇātpratyāśrāvayatyagnīttatpunaradhvaryuṃ yajña upāvartate // so 'dhvaryurnāpavyāharet / ā yajeti vaktoryajetyevādhvaryurhotre yajñaṃ samprayacati //
english: The Âgnîdhra responds: thereby the sacrifice passes back to the Adhvaryu. The Adhvaryu must utter nothing improper until he pronounces (the word) 'yaga (recite the offering-prayer):' in saying 'yaga the Adhvaryu hands the sacrifice on to the Hotri.

sanskrit: sa hotā nāpavyāharet /
english: The Hotri must utter nothing improper until his vashat-call.

sanskrit: ā vaṣaṭkārāttaṃ vaṣaṭkāreṇāgnāveva yonau reto bhūtaṃ siñcatyagnirvai yoniryajñasya sa tataḥ prajāyata iti nu haviryajñe 'tha saumye 'dhvare //
english: By the vashat-call he pours it (the sacrifice) into the fire, as seed into the womb; for the fire is indeed the womb of the sacrifice, from thence it is brought forth. So now at the havis-sacrifice.

sanskrit: sa vai grahaṃ gṛhītvādhvaryuḥ / nāpavyāharedopākaraṇādupāvartadhvamityevādhvaryurudgātṛbhyo yajñaṃ samprayacati //
english: When he has drawn (the Soma), the Adhvaryu must not utter anything improper until his summons[paragraph continues] (for the chanting of the stotra ): with the call 'draw near!' the Adhvaryu hands the sacrifice on to the Udgâtris (chanters).

sanskrit: ta udgātāro nāpavyāhareyuḥ / ottamāyā eṣottametyevodgātāro hotre yajñaṃ samprayacanti //
english: The Udgâtris must not utter anything improper until the last (stotra-verse): 'this is the last one,' thus thinking, the Udgâtris hand on the sacrifice to the Hotri.

sanskrit: sa hotā nāpavyāharet /
english: The Hotri must utter nothing improper until the vashat-call.

sanskrit: ā vaṣaṭkārāttaṃ vaṣaṭkāreṇāgnāveva yonau reto bhūtaṃ siñcatyagnirvai yoniryajñasya sa tataḥ prajāyate //
english: With the vashat-call he pours it (the sacrifice) into the fire, as seed into the womb; for the fire is indeed the womb of the sacrifice, since from thence it is brought forth.

sanskrit: sa yaddha so 'pavyāharet / yaṃ yajña upāvartate yathā pūrṇapātram parāsiñcedevaṃ ha sa yajamānam parāsiñcetsa yatra haivamṛtvijaḥ saṃvidānā yajñena caranti sarvameva tatra kalpate na muhyati tasmādevameva yajño bhartavyaḥ //
english: If he whom the sacrifice approaches were to utter anything improper, he would waste the sacrifice, even as he might waste (water by spilling from) a full vessel. And where the officiating priests thus practice sacrifice with a perfect mutual understanding between them, there everything works regularly and no hitch occurs: therefore it is in this way that the sacrifice must be nursed.

sanskrit: tā vā etāḥ /
english: Now there are here five utterances, viz.

sanskrit: pañca vyāhṛtayo bhavantyo śrāvayāstu śrauṣaḍyaja ye yajāmahe vauṣaḍiti pāṅkto yajñaḥ pāṅktaḥpaśuḥ pañcartavaḥ saṃvatsarasyaiṣaikā yajñasya mātraiṣā sampat //
english: 'Bid (him, Agni, or them) hear!' 'Yea, may he (or, one) hear!' 'Pronounce the prayer to the kindling-sticks!' 'We who pronounce the prayer . . .' 'May he bear (the sacrifice to the gods) !' fivefold is the sacrifice, fivefold the animal victim, five are the seasons of the year: this is the one measure of the sacrifice, this its consummation.

sanskrit: tāsāṃ saptadaśākṣarāṇi / saptadaśo vai prajāpatiḥ prajāpatiryajña eṣaikā yajñasya mātraiṣā sampat //
english: These (five formulas) consist of seventeen syllables;--seventeenfold, indeed, is Pragâpati, and Pragâpati is the sacrifice: this is the one measure of the sacrifice, this its consummation.

sanskrit: o śrāvayeti vai devāḥ / purovātaṃ sasṛjire 'stu śrauṣaḍityabhrāṇi samaplāvayanyajeti vidyutaṃ ye yajāmaha iti stanayitnuṃ vaṣaṭkāreṇaiva prāvarṣayan //
english: With 'O srâvaya !' the gods sent forth the east wind; with 'Astu sraushat !' they caused the clouds to flow together; with 'Yaga (pronounce the yâgyâ)!' (they sent forth) the lightning; with' Ye yagâmahe (we who pray),' the thunder; with the vashat-call they caused it to rain .

sanskrit: yadīṣṭyā vā yajeta darśapūrṇamāsayorvaiva brūyādvṛṣṭikāmo vā asmīti tatro adhvaryuṃ brūyātpurovātaṃ ca vidyutaṃ ca manasā dhyāyetyabhrāṇi manasā dhyāyetyagnīdhaṃ stanayitnuṃ ca varṣaṃ ca manasā dhyāyeti hotāraṃ sarvāṇyetāni manasā dhyāyeti brahmāṇaṃ varṣati haiva tatra yatraivamṛtvijaḥ saṃvidānā yajñena caranti //
english: Should he (the sacrificer) be desirous of rain, or should he perform a special offering , or even at the new- and full-moon sacrifice itself, he may say, 'Verily, I am desirous of rain!'--and he may also say to the Adhvaryu, 'Ponder thou in thy mind the east wind and the lightning!'--to the Âgnîdhra, 'Ponder thou the clouds in thy mind!'--to the Hotri, 'Ponder thou in thy mind the thunder and rain!'--to the Brahman, 'Ponder thou all, these in thy mind!'--for where the officiating priests thus practice sacrifice with a perfect mutual understanding between them, there it will indeed rain.

sanskrit: o śrāvayeti vai devāḥ /
english: With 'O srâvaya!' the gods called the shining one (virâg, viz.

sanskrit: virājamabhyājuhuvurastu śrauṣaḍiti vatsamupāvāsṛjanyajetyudajayanye yajāmaha ityupāsīdanvaṣaṭkāreṇaiva virājamaduhateyaṃ vai virāḍasyai vā eṣa doha evaṃ ha vā asmā iyaṃ virāṭsarvāṅkāmānduhe ya evametaṃ virājo dohaṃ veda //
english: cow), with 'Astu sraushat!' they untied the calf and let it go to her; with 'Yaga!' they raised (its head to the udder of the cow) ; with[paragraph continues] 'Ye yagâmahe!' they sat down by her (for milking); with the vashat-call they milked her. The shining one, doubtless, is this (earth), and of her this is the milking: and for him who knows this to be the milking of the shining one, this shining (earth-cow) thus milks out all his desires.

sanskrit: ṛtavo ha vai prayājāḥ / tasmātpañca bhavanti pañca hyṛtavaḥ //
english: The fore-offerings (prayâga), assuredly, are the seasons: hence there are five of them, for there are five seasons.

sanskrit: devāśca vā asurāśca / ubhaye prājāpatyāḥ paspṛdhira etasminyajñe prajāpatau pitari saṃvatsare 'smākamayaṃ bhaviṣyatyasmākamayam bhaviṣyatīti //
english: The gods and the Asuras, both of them sprang from Pragâpati, were once contending for this sacrifice, (which is) their father Pragâpati, the year: 'Ours it (he) shall be!' 'Ours it (he) shall be!' they said.

sanskrit: tato devāḥ /
english: Then the gods went on praising and toiling.

sanskrit: arcantaḥ śrāmyantaścerurasta etānprayājāndadṛśustairayajanta tairṛtūntsaṃvatsaram prājayannṛtubhyaḥ saṃvatsarātsapatnānantarāyaṃstasmātprajayāḥ prajayā ha vai nāmaitadyatprayājā iti tatho evaiṣa etairṛtūntsaṃvatsaram prayajatyṛtubhyaḥ saṃvatsarātsapatnānantareti tasmātprayājairyajate //
english: They saw these fore-offerings and worshipped with them. By means of them they gained (pra-gi) the seasons, the year; they deprived their rivals of the seasons, of the year: hence (the fore-offerings are) victories (pragaya), for, assuredly, pragaya is the very same term as prayâga (fore-offering) . And in the same way this one (the sacrificer) wins by means of them the seasons, the year; deprives his rivals of the seasons, of the year. This is the reason why he performs the fore-offerings.

sanskrit: te vā ājyahaviṣo bhavanti /
english: The sacrificial food at these offerings consists ofclarified butter.

sanskrit: vajro vā ājyametena vai devā vajreṇājyenartūntsaṃvatsaram prājayannṛtubhyaḥ saṃvatsarātsapatnānantarāyaṃstatho evaiṣa etena vajreṇājyenartūntsaṃvatsaram prajayatyṛtubhyaḥ saṃvatsarātsapatnānantareti tasmādājyahaviṣo bhavanti //
english: Now the butter, indeed, is a thunderbolt, and with that thunderbolt, the butter, the gods gained the seasons, the year, and deprived their rivals of the seasons, of the year. And with that thunderbolt, the butter, he now, in the same way, gains the seasons, the year, and deprives his enemies of the seasons, of the year.

sanskrit: etadvai saṃvatsarasya svam payaḥ /
english: For this reason clarified butter forms the sacrificial food at these (offerings).

sanskrit: yadājyaṃ tatsvenaivainametatpayasā devāḥ svyakurvata tatho evainameṣa etatsvenaiva payasā svīkurute tasmādājyahaviṣo bhavanti //
